2.3.m: Having adorned the trees with garlands, one should embellish them with ornaments and the like; / one should then give plant-fertilising liquid and establish them with a cold stream [of water].

2.3.s:
bhojayetpaṃcaviprāṃśca puratoṃ'te viśeṣataḥ ..
karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā utsṛjedvāsyapūrvakam.. .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
भोजयेत्पंचविप्रांश्च पुरतोंऽते विशेषतः ॥
कर्णवेधं ततः कृत्वा उत्सृजेद्वास्यपूर्वकम्॥ ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: One should feed five Brahmins in front and especially at the end; / then, having performed the ear-piercing rite, one should release it after performing the preliminary blessing.

2.3.s:
dadyādyūpaṃ madhyadeśe ropayetkadalīṃ tataḥ ..
raṃbhāṃ ca ropayeddikṣu sthālīpākavidhānataḥ .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
दद्याद्यूपं मध्यदेशे रोपयेत्कदलीं ततः ॥
रंभां च रोपयेद्दिक्षु स्थालीपाकविधानतः ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: One should place a sacrificial post in the middle, and then plant a plantain; / and one should plant a banana tree in the quarters, according to the rule of the boiled sacrificial dish.

2.3.s:
aṣṭāvaṣṭau ca juhuyādanyeṣāṃ ca ghṛtena tu ..
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsviṣṭakṛttadanaṃtaram .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
अष्टावष्टौ च जुहुयादन्येषां च घृतेन तु ॥
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्यात्स्विष्टकृत्तदनंतरम् ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m: One should offer eight oblations each to the others with clarified butter; / immediately thereafter, one should offer a single oblation to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt.

2.3.s:
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyātpūrṇāṃ dadyādgṛhaṃ vrajet .. 7 ..
śreṣṭhavṛkṣapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
दक्षिणां च ततो दद्यात्पूर्णां दद्याद्गृहं व्रजेत् ॥ 7 ॥
श्रेष्ठवृक्षप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
One should then give a priestly gift, offer the final oblation, and go home.
Description of the Procedure for the Consecration of an Excellent Tree

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ekādivaravṛkṣāṇāṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye dvijottamāḥ ..
vṛkṣasya paścime bhāge sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
एकादिवरवृक्षाणां विधिं वक्ष्ये द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
वृक्षस्य पश्चिमे भागे स्थापयेत्कलशं ततः ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / I shall explain the rule for single and other excellent trees, O best of the twice-born. / On the western side of the tree, one should then install a water pot.

2.3.s:
vṛkṣaṃ saṃsthāpayetpūrvaṃ sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet ..
brahmāṇaṃ kalaśebhyaśca somaṃ viṣṇuṃ vanaspatim .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
वृक्षं संस्थापयेत्पूर्वं सूत्रेण परिवेष्टयेत् ॥
ब्रह्माणं कलशेभ्यश्च सोमं विष्णुं वनस्पतिम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: One should first establish the tree and wrap it around with a thread; / [and invoke] Brahmā, Soma, Viṣṇu, and Vanaspati from the pots.

2.3.s:
tatastilayavairhomānaṣṭāṣṭau vidhivaccaret ..
samutsṛjya tato yūpaṃ kadalyā saha dharmavit .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
ततस्तिलयवैर्होमानष्टाष्टौ विधिवच्चरेत् ॥
समुत्सृज्य ततो यूपं कदल्या सह धर्मवित् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: Then, one who knows dharma should perform eight fire offerings each with sesame and barley according to rule, / and then release the sacrificial post together with a plantain.

2.3.s:
vṛkṣamūle yajeddharmaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca viśaṃ tathā ..
digīśāṃśca tathā yakṣānnācāryaṃ toṣayettataḥ.. 4..
2.3.d:
वृक्षमूले यजेद्धर्मं पृथिवीं च विशं तथा ॥
दिगीशांश्च तथा यक्षान्नाचार्यं तोषयेत्ततः॥ 4॥
2.3.m: At the base of the tree he should sacrifice to Dharma, to the earth, to the people, / and to the guardians of the directions and the yakṣas; then he should gratify the preceptor.

2.3.s:
dhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddohadaṃ vṛkṣapūjanam ..
kṛtvā samyagvidhānena savitre'rghyaṃ nivedayet .. 5 ..
aśvatthapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
धेनुं च दक्षिणां दद्याद्दोहदं वृक्षपूजनम् ॥
कृत्वा सम्यग्विधानेन सवित्रेऽर्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
अश्वत्थप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
He should give a cow as the sacrificial fee, perform the arboricultural rite and worship of the tree, / and having properly performed [everything] according to rule, he should present the water-offering to Savitṛ.
Description of the procedure for the consecration of the aśvattha tree

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athāśvatthapratiṣṭhāyāṃ mūle bāhupramāṇakam ..
sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettatra caṃdanenāṅkitaṃ yathā .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अथाश्वत्थप्रतिष्ठायां मूले बाहुप्रमाणकम् ॥
स्थण्डिलं कारयेत्तत्र चंदनेनाङ्कितं यथा ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / Now, in the consecration of an aśvattha tree, he should make an altar at its base / measuring an arm's length, marked there with sandalwood.

2.3.s:
padmaṃ prakalpayettatra sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca ..
pūrvedyu rātrisamaye tadviṣṇoriti vai ṛcā .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
पद्मं प्रकल्पयेत्तत्र सामान्यार्घ्यं विधाय च ॥
पूर्वेद्यु रात्रिसमये तद्विष्णोरिति वै ऋचा ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: He should fashion a lotus there, and having made the general water-offering / on the previous night with the verse beginning 'tad viṣṇoḥ',

2.3.s:
sthāpayedvāriṇā pūrṇaṃ kayā neti ca gaṃdhakam ..
gaṃdhadvāreti tailena śrīśca teti ca caṃdanam .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
स्थापयेद्वारिणा पूर्णं कया नेति च गंधकम् ॥
गंधद्वारेति तैलेन श्रीश्च तेति च चंदनम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: he should place [a jar] filled with water, and fragrant substances with 'kayā naḥ', / [anoint it] with oil with 'gandhadvārām', and with sandalwood paste with 'śrīś ca te'.

2.3.s:
dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ kalye brāhmaṇatrayabhojanam ..
kārayetsitasūtraiśca veṣṭayeccaṃdanasya ca .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
दद्याद्दूर्वाक्षतं कल्ये ब्राह्मणत्रयभोजनम् ॥
कारयेत्सितसूत्रैश्च वेष्टयेच्चंदनस्य च ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: At daybreak he should offer dūrvā grass and unbroken grain, feed three brahmins, / wrap [the tree] with white threads, and [anoint it] with sandalwood paste.

2.3.s:
kumbhe vināyakaṃ pūjya brahmāṇaṃ ca pare ghaṭe ..
svadikṣu dikpatīṃścāpi vṛkṣamūle navagrahān .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
कुम्भे विनायकं पूज्य ब्रह्माणं च परे घटे ॥
स्वदिक्षु दिक्पतींश्चापि वृक्षमूले नवग्रहान् ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: Having worshipped Vināyaka in a pot and Brahmā in another jar, / and also the guardians of the directions in their respective quarters, and the nine planets at the base of the tree,

2.3.s:
maṃḍale śivamabhyarcyaṃ pīṭhapūjā puraḥsaram ..
pūrve caṃḍaṃ pracaṃḍaṃ ca dakṣiṇe naṃdibhṛṃgiṇau ..6..
2.3.d:
मंडले शिवमभ्यर्च्यं पीठपूजा पुरःसरम् ॥
पूर्वे चंडं प्रचंडं च दक्षिणे नंदिभृंगिणौ ॥6॥
2.3.m: he should worship Śiva in the diagram, preceded by worship of the seat: / Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa in the east, Nandin and Bhṛṅgin in the south,

2.3.s:
anaṃtaṃ paścime kāmamuttare gaṇanāyakam ..
kārtikeyaṃ madhyadeśa ādhāraśaktipūrvakam..7...
2.3.d:
अनंतं पश्चिमे काममुत्तरे गणनायकम् ॥
कार्तिकेयं मध्यदेश आधारशक्तिपूर्वकम्॥7॥।
2.3.m: Ananta in the west, Kāma in the north, Gaṇanāyaka / and Kārtikeya in the middle, preceded by the power of the support (Ādhāraśakti),

2.3.s:
anaṃtaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva trivṛttaṃ ca trimaṃḍalam..
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śvetaṃ vṛṣabhameva ca .. 8..
2.3.d:
अनंतं पृथिवीं चैव त्रिवृत्तं च त्रिमंडलम्॥
अथ ध्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्वेतं वृषभमेव च ॥ 8॥
2.3.m: and Ananta, the earth, the triple fold, and the three circles. / Now I shall explain the visualisation: on a white bull,

2.3.s:
dvibhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam..
āropayetsvataṃtreṇa mūle viṣṇuṃ samarcayet..9..
2.3.d:
द्विभुजं शूलहस्तं च सर्वाभरणसंयुतम्॥
आरोपयेत्स्वतंत्रेण मूले विष्णुं समर्चयेत्॥9॥
2.3.m: two-armed, with a trident in hand, endowed with all ornaments. / He should set it up independently; at the base he should worship Viṣṇu,

2.3.s:
śaṃkaraṃ ca tathā madhye agre brahmāṇakaṃ yajet..
baliṃ ca piṣṭakānnaṃ ca dattvā ca śrapayeccarum..2.3.8.10..
2.3.d:
शंकरं च तथा मध्ये अग्रे ब्रह्माणकं यजेत्॥
बलिं च पिष्टकान्नं च दत्त्वा च श्रपयेच्चरुम्॥2.3.8.10॥
2.3.m: and Śaṅkara in the middle, and at the top he should sacrifice to Brahmā. / Having offered a bali and flour-cake food, he should boil the sacrificial porridge.

2.3.s:
juhuyādrudramuddiśya rudrasaṃkhyāhutiṃ kramāt ..
anyeṣāṃ ca sruveṇaiva homaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ .. 11 ..
2.3.d:
जुहुयाद्रुद्रमुद्दिश्य रुद्रसंख्याहुतिं क्रमात् ॥
अन्येषां च स्रुवेणैव होमं दद्यात्प्रयत्नतः ॥ 11 ॥
2.3.m: He should offer into the fire dedicated to Rudra oblations numbering eleven in sequence, / and with the ladle he should diligently make the oblation to the others.

2.3.s:
ropayetkadalīvṛkṣamācāryaṃ paritoṣayet ..
kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ paṃcadhārāṃ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇām .. 12 ..
2.3.d:
रोपयेत्कदलीवृक्षमाचार्यं परितोषयेत् ॥
कृत्वा पूर्णां पंचधारां कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.3.m: He should plant a banana tree and satisfy the preceptor. / Having performed the complete oblation with a stream of five [liquids] and made a circumambulation,

2.3.s:
kṣīradhārāṃ ca saṃpādya arghyaṃ dattvā gṛhaṃ vrajet .. 13 .. ..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi tṛtīyabhāge'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 8 ..
vaṭapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
क्षीरधारां च संपाद्य अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा गृहं व्रजेत् ॥ 13 ॥ ॥
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे मध्यमपर्वणि तृतीयभागेऽष्टमोऽध्यायः ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
वटप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
and having poured a stream of milk and offered the water-offering, he should go home.
Thus ends the eighth chapter in the third part of the Madhyamaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the procedure for the consecration of the banyan tree

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vaṭasthānamatho vakṣye tasya mūle tu dakṣiṇe ..
trihastavedimupari sthāpayetkalaśatrayam .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वटस्थानमथो वक्ष्ये तस्य मूले तु दक्षिणे ॥
त्रिहस्तवेदिमुपरि स्थापयेत्कलशत्रयम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall explain the site of the banyan tree: at its base, on the south side, / he should place three pots upon a three-cubit altar.

2.3.s:
gaṇeśaṃ ca śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayitvā huneccarum ..
raktasūtraistriguṇitaiḥ svarṇameva puraḥsaram.. 2 ..
2.3.d:
गणेशं च शिवं विष्णुं पूजयित्वा हुनेच्चरुम् ॥
रक्तसूत्रैस्त्रिगुणितैः स्वर्णमेव पुरःसरम्॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: Having worshipped Gaṇeśa, Śiva, and Viṣṇu, he should offer the sacrificial porridge into the fire, / using triple-stranded red cords, preceded by gold itself.

2.3.s:
yavakṣīrabaliṃ dadyādutsṛjedvākyamuccaran..
yūpamāropayetpaścādvaṭamūlaiḥ samarpayet .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
यवक्षीरबलिं दद्यादुत्सृजेद्वाक्यमुच्चरन्॥
यूपमारोपयेत्पश्चाद्वटमूलैः समर्पयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: He should offer a bali of barley and milk, and release it while reciting the formula. / Then he should set up a sacrificial post and dedicate it at the base of the banyan tree,

2.3.s:
yakṣānnāgāṃśca gaṃdharvānsiddhāṃścaiva marudgaṇān .. 4 .. ..
bilvapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
यक्षान्नागांश्च गंधर्वान्सिद्धांश्चैव मरुद्गणान् ॥ 4 ॥ ॥
बिल्वप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
to the yakṣas, nāgas, gandharvas, siddhas, and the hosts of the Maruts.
Description of the procedure for the consecration of the bilva tree

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vakṣye bilvapratiṣṭhāṃ ca pūrvedyuradhivāsayet ..
tryaṃbakaṃ ceti maṃtreṇa sthāpayedgaṃdhavāriṇā .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वक्ष्ये बिल्वप्रतिष्ठां च पूर्वेद्युरधिवासयेत् ॥
त्र्यंबकं चेति मंत्रेण स्थापयेद्गंधवारिणा ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / I shall explain the consecration of the bilva tree: on the previous day he should perform the preliminary consecration; / with the mantra 'tryambaka...' he should install [it] with fragrant water.

2.3.s:
sunābheti ca maṃtreṇa me gṛhṇāmīti cākṣatam ..
kayāneti tato dhūpaṃ vastraṃ mālyaṃ nivedayet .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
सुनाभेति च मंत्रेण मे गृह्णामीति चाक्षतम् ॥
कयानेति ततो धूपं वस्त्रं माल्यं निवेदयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: With the mantra 'sunābhā...' and with 'me gṛhṇāmi...' [he should present] unbroken grain; / then with 'kayā naḥ...' he should offer incense, cloth, and a garland.

2.3.s:
yajedrudraṃ tato devaṃ madhye durgāṃ dhaneśvaram ..
tataḥ kalye samutthāya nityaṃ nirvartya śāstrataḥ .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
यजेद्रुद्रं ततो देवं मध्ये दुर्गां धनेश्वरम् ॥
ततः कल्ये समुत्थाय नित्यं निर्वर्त्य शास्त्रतः ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: Then he should sacrifice to the god Rudra, and in the middle to Durgā and Kubera. / Then, rising at daybreak, having performed the daily duties according to scripture,

2.3.s:
svagṛhe sapta viprāṃśca bhojayeddvijadaṃpatī ..
mūle hastadvayaṃ dattvā vartulā vedikā bhavet .. .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
स्वगृहे सप्त विप्रांश्च भोजयेद्द्विजदंपती ॥
मूले हस्तद्वयं दत्त्वा वर्तुला वेदिका भवेत् ॥ ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: he should feed seven brahmins and a brahmin couple in his home. / Laying out two cubits at the base, there should be a round altar.

2.3.s:
tatra gairikayuktena kusuṃbhacūrṇakena vā ..
niśāraktena vā kuryādaṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanam.. 5 ..
2.3.d:
तत्र गैरिकयुक्तेन कुसुंभचूर्णकेन वा ॥
निशारक्तेन वा कुर्यादष्टपत्रं सुशोभनम्॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: There he should make a very beautiful eight-petalled [lotus] with red chalk, / or with safflower powder, or with turmeric.

2.3.s:
niveṣṭanaṃ tataḥ kuryādvṛkṣasya dvijasattamāḥ ..
rakta sūtrairveṣṭayecca paṃcasaptanavabhistu .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
निवेष्टनं ततः कुर्याद्वृक्षस्य द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
रक्त सूत्रैर्वेष्टयेच्च पंचसप्तनवभिस्तु ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m: Then, O best of brahmins, he should encircle the tree; / he should wrap it with red threads, five, seven, or nine [times].

2.3.s:
vrīhīṃśca vāpayettatra uttarābhimukhastathā ..
śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ pūjayedbhūtimicchatā .. 7 ..
2.3.d:
व्रीहींश्च वापयेत्तत्र उत्तराभिमुखस्तथा ॥
शिवं विष्णुं च ब्रह्माणं पूजयेद्भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 7 ॥
2.3.m: Facing north, he should sow rice grains there; / one desiring prosperity should worship Śiva, Viṣṇu, and Brahmā.

2.3.s:
śivaṃ ca nāyakaṃ kuryādādityānpatramūlake ..
śeṣaṃ ca tarumūle tu madhye'naṃtaṃ śatakratum .. 8 ..
2.3.d:
शिवं च नायकं कुर्यादादित्यान्पत्रमूलके ॥
शेषं च तरुमूले तु मध्येऽनंतं शतक्रतुम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.3.m: He should place Śiva as the leader, and the Ādityas at the base of the leaves; / Śeṣa at the base of the tree, and Ananta and Indra in the middle;

2.3.s:
vanapālaṃ ca somaṃ ca sūryaṃ pṛdhvīmanukramāt ..
homastilākṣataiḥ kāryo baliṃ dadyādghṛtaudanaiḥ .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
वनपालं च सोमं च सूर्यं पृध्वीमनुक्रमात् ॥
होमस्तिलाक्षतैः कार्यो बलिं दद्याद्घृतौदनैः ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m: the guardian of the forest, Soma, Sūrya, and the earth in succession. / The fire sacrifice should be performed with sesame and unbroken grain, and he should give a bali of boiled rice with ghee,

2.3.s:
yakṣebhyo māṣabhaktaṃ ca vāyanāni ca dvādaśa ..
grahāṇāṃ prītaye dadyātkṣīreṇāveṣṭya dakṣiṇām.. 2.3.10.10
2.3.d:
यक्षेभ्यो माषभक्तं च वायनानि च द्वादश ॥
ग्रहाणां प्रीतये दद्यात्क्षीरेणावेष्ट्य दक्षिणाम्॥ 2.3.10.10
2.3.m: and boiled black gram for the yakṣas, and twelve ceremonial gifts. / For the propitiation of the planets, he should offer a sacrificial fee, wrapping [the tree] with milk,

2.3.s:
kāṃcanaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ tāmrapātrakam ..
yūpāropaṃ karṇavedhaṃ savitre'rghyaṃ nivedayet .. 11 ..
2.3.d:
कांचनं कांस्यपात्रं च तांबूलं ताम्रपात्रकम् ॥
यूपारोपं कर्णवेधं सवित्रेऽर्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
2.3.m: along with gold, a bell-metal vessel, betel, and a copper vessel. / He should set up the sacrificial post, perform the ear-piercing rite, and offer the water-offering to Savitṛ.

2.3.s:
atha rātripratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye śāstrānusārataḥ ..
yakṣaikavṛkṣasaṃskāre na punarjāyate bhuvi .. 12 ..
2.3.d:
अथ रात्रिप्रतिष्ठां च वक्ष्ये शास्त्रानुसारतः ॥
यक्षैकवृक्षसंस्कारे न पुनर्जायते भुवि ॥ 12 ॥
2.3.m: Now I shall describe the nocturnal consecration according to scripture; / when the rite for a single yakṣa-inhabited tree is performed, one is not born again on earth.

2.3.s:
pūrvedyurupavāhe tu vṛkṣamūle ghaṭaṃ nyaset ..
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca pūjayitvā tu sthāpayet.. 13 ..
2.3.d:
पूर्वेद्युरुपवाहे तु वृक्षमूले घटं न्यसेत् ॥
विष्णुं शिवं गणेशं च पूजयित्वा तु स्थापयेत्॥ 13 ॥
2.3.m: When fasting on the previous day, he should place a jar at the base of the tree; / having worshipped Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Gaṇeśa, he should install [it],

2.3.s:
kalaśānpañca vā sapta gaṃdhatailairalaṃkṛtān ..
dugdhena paṃcagavyena śaṃkhatoyena yatnataḥ ..14..
2.3.d:
कलशान्पञ्च वा सप्त गंधतैलैरलंकृतान् ॥
दुग्धेन पंचगव्येन शंखतोयेन यत्नतः ॥14॥
2.3.m: and five or seven pots adorned with fragrant oils, / with milk, the five bovine products, and water from a conch, with diligence.

2.3.s:
sūtraiḥ saṃveṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā vastramālyairanaṃtaram..
kāṃḍāditi ca maṃtreṇa dadyāddūrvā kṣataṃ tataḥ .. 15..
2.3.d:
सूत्रैः संवेष्टनं कृत्वा वस्त्रमाल्यैरनंतरम्॥
कांडादिति च मंत्रेण दद्याद्दूर्वा क्षतं ततः ॥ 15॥
2.3.m: Having wound cords around [it], followed by clothes and garlands, / he should then present dūrvā grass and unbroken grain with the mantra beginning 'kāṇḍāt'.

2.3.s:
viṣṇusūktena ca punaḥ siṃdūrāṃjanacaṃdanam..
dadyātphalaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca svayaṃ tatra svapettataḥ..16..
2.3.d:
विष्णुसूक्तेन च पुनः सिंदूरांजनचंदनम्॥
दद्यात्फलं च दीपं च स्वयं तत्र स्वपेत्ततः॥16॥
2.3.m: And again, with the Viṣṇu hymn, [he should offer] red lead, collyrium, and sandalwood paste; / he should present fruit and a lamp, and then sleep there himself.

2.3.s: hunetpaṃcāhutīstatra yūpaṃ dadyātsamutsṛjet.. 18 ..
2.3.d: हुनेत्पंचाहुतीस्तत्र यूपं दद्यात्समुत्सृजेत्॥ 18 ॥
2.3.m: He should offer five oblations there into the fire, set up a sacrificial post, and release it.

2.3.s:
baliṃ ca pāyasenaiva prakuryātkarṇavedhanam ..
veṣṭayetkṣīratoyena dhānyaṃ dhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇām ..19..
2.3.d:
बलिं च पायसेनैव प्रकुर्यात्कर्णवेधनम् ॥
वेष्टयेत्क्षीरतोयेन धान्यं धेनुं च दक्षिणाम् ॥19॥
2.3.m: He should offer a bali with milk-rice pudding and perform the ear-piercing rite; / he should encircle [the tree] with milk and water, and give grain and a cow as the sacrificial fee.

2.3.s:
dadyādarghyaṃ hunetpūrṇaṃ bhojayeddvijadaṃpatī .. 20 .. ..
sadvṛkṣapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
दद्यादर्घ्यं हुनेत्पूर्णं भोजयेद्द्विजदंपती ॥ 20 ॥ ॥
सद्वृक्षप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
He should give the water-offering, offer the final oblation into the fire, and feed a brahmin couple.
Description of the procedure for the consecration of auspicious trees

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śatahastamitāṃ muṣṭiṃ nānātaruvibhūṣitām ..
pūgāmrādiphalairyuktaṃ vāstuṃ kṛtvā yajettu yaḥ .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
शतहस्तमितां मुष्टिं नानातरुविभूषिताम् ॥
पूगाम्रादिफलैर्युक्तं वास्तुं कृत्वा यजेत्तु यः ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / Whoever, having made a site measuring a hundred cubits, adorned with various trees / and endowed with fruits such as areca and mango, performs sacrifice,

2.3.s:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke vasecciram..
tadvidhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāśāstrānusārataḥ .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके वसेच्चिरम्॥
तद्विधानं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाशास्त्रानुसारतः ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: dwells in the world of heaven for sixty thousand years. / I shall explain that procedure according to scripture.

2.3.s:
nityaṃ nirvartya vidhivatpaṃca viprānsamarcayet ..
bhojayetpūjayedviṣṇuṃ prajāpatisamanvitam .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
नित्यं निर्वर्त्य विधिवत्पंच विप्रान्समर्चयेत् ॥
भोजयेत्पूजयेद्विष्णुं प्रजापतिसमन्वितम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: Having properly performed the daily rites, he should honour five brahmins; / he should feed them, and worship Viṣṇu accompanied by Prajāpati.

2.3.s:
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām .. 4 .. ..
maṇḍapapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
अग्निकार्यं ततः कृत्वा दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥ 4 ॥ ॥
मण्डपप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
Then, having performed the fire ritual, he should give a priestly gift to the brahmin.
Description of the rules for the consecration of a pavilion

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pratiṣṭhāṃ maṃḍapasyaiva śailadārumayasya ca ..
tṛṇakāṣṭhasya ca vibho tṛṇavattasya ca dvijāḥ .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रतिष्ठां मंडपस्यैव शैलदारुमयस्य च ॥
तृणकाष्ठस्य च विभो तृणवत्तस्य च द्विजाः ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / O brahmins, [I shall declare] the consecration of a pavilion made of stone and wood, / and of one made of grass and wood, O mighty one, as well as of one made purely of grass.

2.3.s:
adhivāsasya pūrvedyuḥ śubhe lagne ghaṭaṃ nyaset ..
sūryaṃ somaṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ kalaśe tu samarcayet .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
अधिवासस्य पूर्वेद्युः शुभे लग्ने घटं न्यसेत् ॥
सूर्यं सोमं तथा विष्णुं कलशे तु समर्चयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: On the day before the preliminary consecration, at an auspicious astrological moment, he should set down a pot. / And in the jar he should worship Sūrya, Soma, and Viṣṇu.

2.3.s:
prokṣayetkuśatoyena āpohiṣṭheti vai ṛcā ..
āpyāyasveti gaṃdhena gaṃdhadvāreti gaṃdhakam .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
प्रोक्षयेत्कुशतोयेन आपोहिष्ठेति वै ऋचा ॥
आप्यायस्वेति गंधेन गंधद्वारेति गंधकम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: He should sprinkle it with kuśa-water using the verse beginning with 'āpo hi ṣṭhā', / with perfume using 'āpyāyasva', and with fragrant paste using 'gandhadvārām'.

2.3.s:
ākṛṣṇeneti tailena śrīśca te iti caṃdanam ..
siṃdūrālaktakaṃ dadyādaṃjanaṃ pūrvayā saha .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
आकृष्णेनेति तैलेन श्रीश्च ते इति चंदनम् ॥
सिंदूरालक्तकं दद्यादंजनं पूर्वया सह ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: He should offer oil with 'ākṛṣṇena', and sandalwood paste with 'śrīś ca te'. / He should offer vermilion and red lac, and collyrium along with the former [verse].

2.3.s:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale śrāddhaṃ vṛddhyātmakaṃ caret ..
dikpālāṃścaiva vinyasya maṃḍape śubhalakṣaṇe .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
ततः प्रभाते विमले श्राद्धं वृद्ध्यात्मकं चरेत् ॥
दिक्पालांश्चैव विन्यस्य मंडपे शुभलक्षणे ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: Then, at a clear dawn, he should perform a funerary rite for prosperity. / And having installed the guardians of the directions in the pavilion possessed of auspicious marks,

2.3.s:
madhye vedyaṃtare caiva rājabhirmaḍalaṃ likhet ..
sūryamāvāhayettatra somaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca pārśvayoḥ .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
मध्ये वेद्यंतरे चैव राजभिर्मडलं लिखेत् ॥
सूर्यमावाहयेत्तत्र सोमं विष्णुं च पार्श्वयोः ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m: in the middle, within the altar, he should draw a mandala with [lines of] pollen. / There he should invoke Sūrya, and on both sides Soma and Viṣṇu.

2.3.s:
gaṇeśaṃ ca grahāṃścaiva dikpālāṃśca ghaṭe'rcayet ..
pāyasaṃ juhuyādagnāvaṣṭottaraśataṃ tathā .. 7 ..
2.3.d:
गणेशं च ग्रहांश्चैव दिक्पालांश्च घटेऽर्चयेत् ॥
पायसं जुहुयादग्नावष्टोत्तरशतं तथा ॥ 7 ॥
2.3.m: In the pot he should worship Gaṇeśa, the planets, and the guardians of the directions. / Likewise, he should offer one hundred and eight oblations of milk-rice into the fire.

2.3.s:
ādityasya tathā viṣṇoḥ somasya dvādaśāhutīḥ ..
baliṃ ca pāyasaṃ dadyāttailaṃ kṣīramathāpi vā .. 8 ..
2.3.d:
आदित्यस्य तथा विष्णोः सोमस्य द्वादशाहुतीः ॥
बलिं च पायसं दद्यात्तैलं क्षीरमथापि वा ॥ 8 ॥
2.3.m: He should make twelve oblations for Āditya, Viṣṇu, and Soma, / and he should present an offering of milk-rice, or else of oil and milk.

2.3.s:
tata utsṛjya vidhivadvākyametadudīrayet ..
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā śanairoṣṭhaṃ na cālayet .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
तत उत्सृज्य विधिवद्वाक्यमेतदुदीरयेत् ॥
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा शनैरोष्ठं न चालयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m: Then, having ritually released [the pavilion] according to rule, he should utter this formula; / going down to the ground on both knees, he should slowly not move his lips [loudly].

2.3.s:
vāstoṣpatiṃ ca tatraiva pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ ..
arghyaṃ dadyācca vidhivadbhūnaivāhutiṃ hunet.. 2.3.12.10 ..
2.3.d:
वास्तोष्पतिं च तत्रैव पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः ॥
अर्घ्यं दद्याच्च विधिवद्भूनैवाहुतिं हुनेत्॥ 2.3.12.10 ॥
2.3.m: Right there he should also worship Vāstoṣpati with perfumes and sandalwood pastes; / he should offer the arghya according to rule and make an oblation on the ground itself.

2.3.s:
( oṃ adyetyādi brāhmaṇādisarvasattvebhyo viṣṇuprīṇanārthamimaṃ maṇḍapaṃ supūjitaṃ sūryadaivataṃ śaileyeṣṭakādibhiḥ sarvasattvebhyo racitaṃ śrutismṛtyuktaphalaprāptikāmanayā amukaṛṣisagotraḥ amukadevaśarmāhamutsṛje ..)
tataḥ śvetaghaṭaṃ dadyānmaṇḍapopari sattamāḥ ..
triguṇena niśāktairvā veṣṭayedvāridhārayā .. .. 11 ..
2.3.d:
( ओं अद्येत्यादि ब्राह्मणादिसर्वसत्त्वेभ्यो विष्णुप्रीणनार्थमिमं मण्डपं सुपूजितं सूर्यदैवतं शैलेयेष्टकादिभिः सर्वसत्त्वेभ्यो रचितं श्रुतिस्मृत्युक्तफलप्राप्तिकामनया अमुकऋषिसगोत्रः अमुकदेवशर्माहमुत्सृजे ॥)
ततः श्वेतघटं दद्यान्मण्डपोपरि सत्तमाः ॥
त्रिगुणेन निशाक्तैर्वा वेष्टयेद्वारिधारया ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
2.3.m: ('Om, on this day, etc., for the gratification of Viṣṇu, to all beings beginning with brahmins, I, belonging to such-and-such gotra, Devaśarman by name, release this pavilion, well-worshipped, presided over by Sūrya as its deity, fashioned with stone, bricks, and so forth for all beings, with the desire to attain the fruit proclaimed in the Śruti and Smṛti.') / Then, O best of men, he should place a white pot on top of the pavilion; / he should encircle it with a threefold cord or [cords] smeared with turmeric, or with a stream of water.

2.3.s:
dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivaddadyātsūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet ..
tṛṇaveśmani vai sūryaṃ vāsudevasamanvitam .. 12 ..
2.3.d:
दक्षिणां विधिवद्दद्यात्सूर्यायार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ॥
तृणवेश्मनि वै सूर्यं वासुदेवसमन्वितम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.3.m: He should offer a priestly gift according to rule and present the arghya to Sūrya. / In a house of grass, indeed, [he should worship] Sūrya accompanied by Vāsudeva.

2.3.s:
ghaṭe gaṇeśaṃ varadaṃ varaṃ kṛtvā samutsṛjet ..
aiśānyāṃ dāpayedyūpaṃ dhvajāndikṣu prakalpayet .. 13 ..
2.3.d:
घटे गणेशं वरदं वरं कृत्वा समुत्सृजेत् ॥
ऐशान्यां दापयेद्यूपं ध्वजान्दिक्षु प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 13 ॥
2.3.m: Having granted the choice boon of Gaṇeśa the boon-giver upon the pot, he should dedicate it. / He should cause a sacrificial post to be erected in the north-east, and he should set up banners in the cardinal directions.

2.3.s:
maṇḍapopari kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya mantramuccaret ..
prapāyāṃ varuṇaḥ pūjyo viśvakarmā prayatnataḥ... 14 ..
2.3.d:
मण्डपोपरि कलशं संस्थाप्य मन्त्रमुच्चरेत् ॥
प्रपायां वरुणः पूज्यो विश्वकर्मा प्रयत्नतः॥। 14 ॥
2.3.m: Having installed the jar on top of the pavilion, he should recite the mantra. / In a water-station, Varuṇa must be worshipped, and Viśvakarman with special care.

2.3.s:
pṛthivīṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ ca pūjayitvā hunedghṛtam ..
sarvavarjyamidaṃ vākyaṃ dhvajamātraṃ vidhīyate .. 15 .. ..
mahāyūpanirmāṇapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
2.3.d:
पृथिवीं च गणेशं च पूजयित्वा हुनेद्घृतम् ॥
सर्ववर्ज्यमिदं वाक्यं ध्वजमात्रं विधीयते ॥ 15 ॥ ॥
महायूपनिर्माणप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम्
2.3.m:
Having worshipped the Earth and Gaṇeśa, he should offer clarified butter. / This statement excludes all [other objects]; merely the banner is prescribed.
Description of the fashioning and consecration of a great sacrificial post

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
caturhastaṃ mahāyūpaṃ hastaṣoḍaśanirmitam ..
vakṣye taṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca rātrau trairātrikaṃ yajet .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
चतुर्हस्तं महायूपं हस्तषोडशनिर्मितम् ॥
वक्ष्ये तं च प्रतिष्ठां च रात्रौ त्रैरात्रिकं यजेत् ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / I shall declare the great sacrificial post of four cubits, constructed up to sixteen cubits, / and its consecration; at night, one should perform a three-night sacrifice.

2.3.s:
varuṇaṃ sitakuṃbhe ca prapākūpasya paścime ..
gāyatryā snāpayetpūrva māpohiṣṭheti vai kramāt .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
वरुणं सितकुंभे च प्रपाकूपस्य पश्चिमे ॥
गायत्र्या स्नापयेत्पूर्व मापोहिष्ठेति वै क्रमात् ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: He should first bathe Varuṇa in a white jar to the west of the water-station's well / with the Gāyatrī mantra, and then with the verse beginning with 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' in due order.

2.3.s:
gaṃdhadvāreti gandhaṃ ca aṃśunā ceti tailakam ..
manonnā iti kusumaṃ dhūrasīti ca dhūpakam .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
गंधद्वारेति गन्धं च अंशुना चेति तैलकम् ॥
मनोन्ना इति कुसुमं धूरसीति च धूपकम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: [He should offer] perfume with 'gandhadvārām', oil with 'aṃśunā', / a flower with 'manonnāḥ', and incense with 'dhūr asi'.

2.3.s:
kayāneti dadedvastraṃ naivedyaṃ dīpacandanam ..
ādau śrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃte vidhīyate .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
कयानेति ददेद्वस्त्रं नैवेद्यं दीपचन्दनम् ॥
आदौ श्राद्धं न कर्तव्यं प्रतिष्ठांते विधीयते ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: He should give a garment with 'kayā naḥ', as well as food offerings, a lamp, and sandalwood paste. / A funerary rite is not to be performed at the beginning; it is prescribed at the conclusion of the consecration.

2.3.s:
daṃpatībhojanaṃ kuryādvarayedekabrāhmaṇam ..
maṃḍape cāṣṭahaste ca kalaśaṃ tatra vinyaset.. 5 ..
2.3.d:
दंपतीभोजनं कुर्याद्वरयेदेकब्राह्मणम् ॥
मंडपे चाष्टहस्ते च कलशं तत्र विन्यसेत्॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: He should feed a married couple and choose one brahmin [as priest]. / In a pavilion of eight cubits, he should place a jar there.

2.3.s:
pūjayedvaruṇaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇasamanvitam ..
śivaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ caiva svaiḥ svairmantrairyathākramāt .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
पूजयेद्वरुणं देवं नारायणसमन्वितम् ॥
शिवं च पृथिवीं चैव स्वैः स्वैर्मन्त्रैर्यथाक्रमात् ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m: He should worship the god Varuṇa together with Nārāyaṇa, / and Śiva and the Earth, with their respective mantras in due order.

2.3.s:
tataḥ kuśakaṃḍikāṃ kṛtvā sthālīpākavidhānataḥ ..
varuṇaṃ ca samabhyarcya juhuyādāhutīrdaśa ..7..
2.3.d:
ततः कुशकंडिकां कृत्वा स्थालीपाकविधानतः ॥
वरुणं च समभ्यर्च्य जुहुयादाहुतीर्दश ॥7॥
2.3.m: Then, having laid the kuśa grass according to the rule for cooking sacrificial pot-offerings, / and having fully worshipped Varuṇa, he should offer ten oblations.

2.3.s:
anyeṣāṃ ca sruveṇaiva dadyādekāhutiṃ kramāt ..
varuṇasyoktavaruṇaṃ tattvā yāmi tataḥ param .. 8 ..
2.3.d:
अन्येषां च स्रुवेणैव दद्यादेकाहुतिं क्रमात् ॥
वरुणस्योक्तवरुणं तत्त्वा यामि ततः परम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.3.m: And for the others, he should offer one oblation each with the ladling spoon in due order. / For Varuṇa, [the verse] 'varuṇasyoktam', and after that 'tat tvā yāmi'.

2.3.s:
varuṇasyottaṃbhanamasīti ca ābhyāṃ devāṃstathaiva ca ..
yenāpāvakacakṣasā paṃcamaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
वरुणस्योत्तंभनमसीति च आभ्यां देवांस्तथैव च ॥
येनापावकचक्षसा पंचमं समुदाहृतम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m: With 'varuṇasyottambhanam asi' [he should worship] the two, and likewise the gods; / 'yenā pāvakacakṣasā' is cited as the fifth.

2.3.s:
rātrasya yūpamityādi paraṃ ca daśamastakam ..
tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ kṛtvā saptajihvaṃ caruṃ nayet ..2.3.13.10..
2.3.d:
रात्रस्य यूपमित्यादि परं च दशमस्तकम् ॥
ततः स्विष्टकृतं कृत्वा सप्तजिह्वं चरुं नयेत् ॥2.3.13.10॥
2.3.m: 'Rātrasya yūpam' and so on, and another, bringing it to ten. / Then, having made the sviṣṭakṛt offering, he should bring the seven-tongued caru offering.

2.3.s:
iha vetyādikaṃ paṃca tataḥ paṃcāhutiṃ hunet ..
śaṃbhave ca pṛthivyai ca mahā rājāya ca kramāt ..11..
2.3.d:
इह वेत्यादिकं पंच ततः पंचाहुतिं हुनेत् ॥
शंभवे च पृथिव्यै च महा राजाय च क्रमात् ॥11॥
2.3.m: Then he should offer five oblations with the five verses beginning with 'iha vaḥ', / in order to Śambhu, to the Earth, and to the Great King.

2.3.s:
carupāketi naivedyaṃ baliṃ caivāgurūdanam ..
śaṃkarāya ca rudrāya śarvāya paśupataye iti ca ..
ugrāya asanāyeti bhavāya tada naṃtaram .. 12 ..
2.3.d:
चरुपाकेति नैवेद्यं बलिं चैवागुरूदनम् ॥
शंकराय च रुद्राय शर्वाय पशुपतये इति च ॥
उग्राय असनायेति भवाय तद नंतरम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.3.m: The food offering is cooked caru, and the oblation is unboiled rice: / to Śaṅkara, to Rudra, to Śarva, and to Paśupati; / then to Ugra, to Asana, and to Bhava;

2.3.s:
mahādevāya ca punarīśānāyeti ca kramāt ..
carupāketi naivevaṃ baliṃ caivāgurūdanam .. 13 ..
2.3.d:
महादेवाय च पुनरीशानायेति च क्रमात् ॥
चरुपाकेति नैवेवं बलिं चैवागुरूदनम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.3.m: and then to Mahādeva, and to Īśāna in due order. / The food offering is cooked caru, and the oblation is unboiled rice.

2.3.s: vākyapūrvaṃ sṛjettoyaṃ tatra vākkaraṇaṃ śṛṇu .. 14 ..
2.3.d: वाक्यपूर्वं सृजेत्तोयं तत्र वाक्करणं शृणु ॥ 14 ॥
2.3.m: Preceded by the formula, he should release the water. Hear the recitation of the formula for that:

2.3.s:
( oṃ adyetyādi brāhmaṇādisarvasattvebhyaḥ amukagotrasya matpituramukadevaśarmaṇaḥ śrutismṛtyāyuktaṃ kūpapratiṣṭhājanyaphalaprāptaye imaṃ su pūjitaṃ sacchāditaṃ varuṇadaivatamamukasagotraḥ amukadevaśarmāhamutsṛje) ..
dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivad dadyādgāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm .. 15 ..
2.3.d:
( ओं अद्येत्यादि ब्राह्मणादिसर्वसत्त्वेभ्यः अमुकगोत्रस्य मत्पितुरमुकदेवशर्मणः श्रुतिस्मृत्यायुक्तं कूपप्रतिष्ठाजन्यफलप्राप्तये इमं सु पूजितं सच्छादितं वरुणदैवतममुकसगोत्रः अमुकदेवशर्माहमुत्सृजे) ॥
दक्षिणां विधिवद् दद्याद्गां च दद्यात्पयस्विनीम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.3.m: ('Om, on this day, etc., for all beings beginning with brahmins, for the sake of attaining the fruit resulting from the consecration of a well as declared in the Śruti and Smṛti for my father, Devaśarman by name, belonging to such-and-such gotra, I, belonging to such-and-such gotra, Devaśarman by name, release this well, well-worshipped, covered, having Varuṇa as its deity.') / He should offer a priestly gift according to rule, and give a milch cow.

2.3.s:
maṃḍape kṣudrakūpe ca pratiṣṭhāṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ ..
gaṇeśaṃ varuṇaṃ kuṃbhe vidhivatpūjayetsudhīḥ .. 16 ..
2.3.d:
मंडपे क्षुद्रकूपे च प्रतिष्ठां शृणुत द्विजाः ॥
गणेशं वरुणं कुंभे विधिवत्पूजयेत्सुधीः ॥ 16 ॥
2.3.m: O brahmins, hear about the consecration in a pavilion and at a small well: / the wise man should worship Gaṇeśa and Varuṇa in a jar according to rule.

2.3.s:
veṣṭayedraktasūtraiśca dadyāyūpaṃ samutsṛjet ..
dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivad dadyādviprānsaṃ pūjayettataḥ .. 17 ..
puṣpavāṭikāpratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
वेष्टयेद्रक्तसूत्रैश्च दद्यायूपं समुत्सृजेत् ॥
दक्षिणां विधिवद् दद्याद्विप्रान्सं पूजयेत्ततः ॥ 17 ॥
पुष्पवाटिकाप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
He should wrap it with red threads, erect a sacrificial post, and release it. / He should give a priestly gift according to rule, and then worship the brahmins.
Description of the rules for the consecration of a flower garden

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
puṣpārāmapratiṣṭhāṃ tu vakṣye śṛṇvaṃtu vai dvijāḥ ..
madhye vediṃ trihastāṃ ca kṛtvā saṃsthāpayedghaṭam .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
पुष्पारामप्रतिष्ठां तु वक्ष्ये शृण्वंतु वै द्विजाः ॥
मध्ये वेदिं त्रिहस्तां च कृत्वा संस्थापयेद्घटम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / O brahmins, listen, I shall declare the consecration of a flower garden: / having made an altar of three cubits in the middle, one should place a pot.

2.3.s:
adhivāsasya pūrvedyuryathāvadviprabhojanam ..
kṛtvā ghaṭe gaṇeśaṃ ca sūryaṃ somaṃ hutāśanam .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
अधिवासस्य पूर्वेद्युर्यथावद्विप्रभोजनम् ॥
कृत्वा घटे गणेशं च सूर्यं सोमं हुताशनम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: On the day before the preliminary consecration, having properly fed brahmins, / [and having worshipped] Gaṇeśa, Sūrya, Soma, and the Fire in the pot,

2.3.s:
nārāyaṇaṃ sthaṃḍile ca juhuyānmadhupāyasam..
vidhivadyūpamāropya godhūmānsecayedgurau .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
नारायणं स्थंडिले च जुहुयान्मधुपायसम्॥
विधिवद्यूपमारोप्य गोधूमान्सेचयेद्गुरौ ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: and Nārāyaṇa on the bare ground, he should offer honey and milk-rice. / Having erected a sacrificial post according to rule, he should sprinkle wheats over the guru.

2.3.s:
veṣṭayedraktasūtraiśca pradadyācceti dakṣiṇām ..
etaddhārājalenaiva yavānnaṃ saguḍaṃ payaḥ .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
वेष्टयेद्रक्तसूत्रैश्च प्रदद्याच्चेति दक्षिणाम् ॥
एतद्धाराजलेनैव यवान्नं सगुडं पयः ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: He should wrap it with red threads and give a priestly gift. / With this stream of water indeed, [he should offer] barley-food, along with jaggery and milk.

2.3.s:
aiśānyāṃ yūpamāropya vidhivaddvijasattamāḥ ..
karṇavedhaṃ samāropya snāpayetkuśavāriṇā .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
ऐशान्यां यूपमारोप्य विधिवद्द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
कर्णवेधं समारोप्य स्नापयेत्कुशवारिणा ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: Having raised the sacrificial post in the northeast according to rule, O best of the twice-born, / having performed the ear-piercing, one should bathe it with kuśa-water.

2.3.s:
dhānyaṃ yavaṃ ca godhūmaṃ dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ..
śatadhārajalenaiva veṣṭayetparito dvijāḥ .. 6 .. ..
tulasīpratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
धान्यं यवं च गोधूमं दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥
शतधारजलेनैव वेष्टयेत्परितो द्विजाः ॥ 6 ॥ ॥
तुलसीप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
One should give grain, barley, and wheat as a sacrificial fee to a brāhmaṇa. / One should encircle it all around with water from a hundred-holed vessel, O twice-born.
Description of the procedure for the consecration of the tulasī plant

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
jyeṣṭhāṣāḍhe tulasyāśca pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivaccaret ..
yajamānaḥ śuddhadine ekādaśyāmathāpi vā .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
ज्येष्ठाषाढे तुलस्याश्च प्रतिष्ठां विधिवच्चरेत् ॥
यजमानः शुद्धदिने एकादश्यामथापि वा ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / In Jyeṣṭha or Āṣāḍha, the sacrificer should perform the consecration of the tulasī according to rule / on an auspicious day or on the eleventh [lunar day].

2.3.s:
tato rātrau ghaṭaṃ sthāpya pūjayetparameśvaram ..
nārāyaṇaṃ śivaṃ somaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ceṃdrameva ca .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
ततो रात्रौ घटं स्थाप्य पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् ॥
नारायणं शिवं सोमं ब्रह्माणं चेंद्रमेव च ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: Then, having set up a pot at night, he should worship the Supreme Lord, / Nārāyaṇa, Śiva, Soma, Brahmā, and Indra.

2.3.s:
gāyatryā snapanaṃ kuryāttathoktairmaṃtrakairapi ..
kayāneti ca gaṃdhena aśruneti ca tailakam .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
गायत्र्या स्नपनं कुर्यात्तथोक्तैर्मंत्रकैरपि ॥
कयानेति च गंधेन अश्रुनेति च तैलकम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: He should perform the bathing with the Gāyatrī and with the prescribed mantras: / perfume with the mantra beginning with 'kayā naḥ', and oil with 'aśrunā' […];

2.3.s:
tvāṃ gaṃdharveti ca punaḥ puṣpaṃ maṃḍaṃśaneti ca ..
mānastoketi kusumaṃ śrīścateti ca caṃdanam .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
त्वां गंधर्वेति च पुनः पुष्पं मंडंशनेति च ॥
मानस्तोकेति कुसुमं श्रीश्चतेति च चंदनम् ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: and with 'tvāṃ gandharvāḥ', a flower with 'maṇḍam aśana' […], / a flower with 'mā nas toke', and sandalwood paste with 'śrīś ca te';

2.3.s:
vaiśvadevīti ca punarmaṃtreṇānena caṃdanam ..
dūrvāmaṃtreṇa dūrvāśca rūpeṇeti ca darppaṇam .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
वैश्वदेवीति च पुनर्मंत्रेणानेन चंदनम् ॥
दूर्वामंत्रेण दूर्वाश्च रूपेणेति च दर्प्पणम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: and sandalwood paste again with the mantra 'vaiśvadevī'; / dūrvā grass with the dūrvā-mantra, and a mirror with 'rūpeṇa' […];

2.3.s:
phalamaṃtreṇa ca phalaṃ samedheti ca aṃjanam ..
sakuśaiḥ pītasūtrādyairveṣṭayetkṣīradhārayā .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
फलमंत्रेण च फलं समेधेति च अंजनम् ॥
सकुशैः पीतसूत्राद्यैर्वेष्टयेत्क्षीरधारया ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m: fruit with the fruit-mantra, and collyrium with 'samedha' […]. / He should encircle [it] with yellow threads and other items accompanied by kuśa grass, along with a stream of milk.

2.3.s:
śatadhārājalenaiva veṣṭayetsvagṛhaṃ vrajet..
vastreṇāvṛtya vidhivadbudhaḥ kāle ghaṭaṃ nyaset .. 7 ..
2.3.d:
शतधाराजलेनैव वेष्टयेत्स्वगृहं व्रजेत्॥
वस्त्रेणावृत्य विधिवद्बुधः काले घटं न्यसेत् ॥ 7 ॥
2.3.m: Having encircled it with water from a hundred-holed vessel, he should go to his house. / Having covered it with a cloth according to rule, the wise man should set down the pot at the proper time.

2.3.s:
saptapaṃcatribhirvātha tadviṣṇoriti vai ṛcā ..
snāpayedatha sādhvībhiḥ kṛtamaṃgalapūrvakam .. 8 ..
2.3.d:
सप्तपंचत्रिभिर्वाथ तद्विष्णोरिति वै ऋचा ॥
स्नापयेदथ साध्वीभिः कृतमंगलपूर्वकम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.3.m: With seven, five, or three [pots] and with the verse 'tad viṣṇoḥ', / he should then bathe it, preceded by auspicious rites performed by chaste women.

2.3.s:
tataḥ śrāddhaṃ samāpyaiva mātṛpūjāpuraḥsaram ..
ācāryaṃ varayetpūrvaṃ gaṃdhādyaiḥ kusumairapi .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
ततः श्राद्धं समाप्यैव मातृपूजापुरःसरम् ॥
आचार्यं वरयेत्पूर्वं गंधाद्यैः कुसुमैरपि ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m: Then, having completed the śrāddha preceded by the worship of the Mothers, / he should first choose the preceptor with perfume and other offerings, as well as flowers.

2.3.s:
ācārya eva hotā syādbrahmāṇaṃ ca sadasyakam ..
maṃḍape daśahaste'pi vartule sthaṃḍileṣu ca .. 2.3.15.10 ..
2.3.d:
आचार्य एव होता स्याद्ब्रह्माणं च सदस्यकम् ॥
मंडपे दशहस्तेऽपि वर्तुले स्थंडिलेषु च ॥ 2.3.15.10 ॥
2.3.m: The preceptor alone should be the hotṛ, and [he should appoint] the brahman priest and a member of the assembly. / In a pavilion of ten cubits, whether circular or on bare ground,

2.3.s:
sahasraṃ maṃḍalaṃ kuryāttatra nārāyaṇaṃ yajet ..
grahām̐llokeśvarānmadhye ādityāṃśca marudgaṇān.. 11 ..
2.3.d:
सहस्रं मंडलं कुर्यात्तत्र नारायणं यजेत् ॥
ग्रहाम्̐ल्लोकेश्वरान्मध्ये आदित्यांश्च मरुद्गणान्॥ 11 ॥
2.3.m: he should make a diagram of a thousand [parts]; there he should worship Nārāyaṇa, / the planets, and the lords of the worlds in the center, the Ādityas, and the hosts of the Maruts.

2.3.s:
rudrānvasūṃśca kalaśe paritaśca samarcayet ..
tataḥ kuśakaṃḍikāṃ kṛtvā homaṃ tilayavena tu .. 12 ..
2.3.d:
रुद्रान्वसूंश्च कलशे परितश्च समर्चयेत् ॥
ततः कुशकंडिकां कृत्वा होमं तिलयवेन तु ॥ 12 ॥
2.3.m: He should worship the Rudras and the Vasus around the water-pot. / Then, having prepared the ritual kuśa-ground, [he should perform] the fire sacrifice with sesame and barley.

2.3.s:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryādanyeṣāṃ śaktito hunet ..
nārāyaṇaṃ samuddiśya dadyādutsṛjya sattamāḥ .. 13 ..
2.3.d:
अष्टोत्तरशतं कुर्यादन्येषां शक्तितो हुनेत् ॥
नारायणं समुद्दिश्य दद्यादुत्सृज्य सत्तमाः ॥ 13 ॥
2.3.m: He should perform one hundred and eight [oblations], and for the others he should offer oblations according to his capacity. / Dedicated to Nārāyaṇa, he should release [it] and offer it, O best of men.

2.3.s:
madhye yūpaṃ samuddiśya carupākaṃ baliṃ dadet ..
kadalīṃ dikṣu saṃnyasya dhvajāndikṣu praropayet .. 14 ..
2.3.d:
मध्ये यूपं समुद्दिश्य चरुपाकं बलिं ददेत् ॥
कदलीं दिक्षु संन्यस्य ध्वजान्दिक्षु प्ररोपयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
2.3.m: Dedicated to the sacrificial post in the center, he should present cooked caru offering as a tribute. / Having placed plantain trees in the cardinal directions, he should erect banners in the cardinal directions.

2.3.s:
dakṣiṇāṃ kāṃcanaṃ dadyāttilaṃ dhānyaṃ sapuṣpakam ..
dhenuṃ payasvinīṃ dayādveṣṭayetkṣīradhārayā.. 15..
2.3.d:
दक्षिणां कांचनं दद्यात्तिलं धान्यं सपुष्पकम् ॥
धेनुं पयस्विनीं दयाद्वेष्टयेत्क्षीरधारया॥ 15॥
2.3.m: He should give gold as a sacrificial fee, along with sesame, grain, and flowers. / He should give a milch cow, and he should encircle [the plant] with a stream of milk.

2.3.s:
jayaṃtyāḥ somavṛkṣasya tathā somavaṭasya ca ..
panasasya kadaṃbasya niṃbasya dvijasattamāḥ .. 16 ..
2.3.d:
जयंत्याः सोमवृक्षस्य तथा सोमवटस्य च ॥
पनसस्य कदंबस्य निंबस्य द्विजसत्तमाः ॥ 16 ॥
2.3.m: Of the jayaṃtī tree, the soma tree, and the soma-banyan tree, / of the jackfruit, the kadamba, and the neem, O best of the twice-born,

2.3.s:
pāṭalā kanakasyaiva śālmalīniṃbakasya ca..
biṃbāśokavaṭasyaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayet .. 17 ..
2.3.d:
पाटला कनकस्यैव शाल्मलीनिंबकस्य च॥
बिंबाशोकवटस्यैव प्रतिष्ठां नैव कारयेत् ॥ 17 ॥
2.3.m: of the pāṭalā, the kanaka, the silk-cotton, and the neem— / of the bimba, the aśoka, and the banyan, one should not perform a consecration.

2.3.s:
bhadrakasya śamīkoṇacaṃḍātakabakasya ca ..
khadirasyaiva kartavyaṃ karṇavedhaṃ na kārayet ..18..
pratiṣṭhāviśeṣaniyamavarṇanam
2.3.d:
भद्रकस्य शमीकोणचंडातकबकस्य च ॥
खदिरस्यैव कर्तव्यं कर्णवेधं न कारयेत् ॥18॥
प्रतिष्ठाविशेषनियमवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
Of the bhadraka, the śamī, the koṇa, the caṇḍātaka, the baka, / and of the khadira, it should be done; one should not perform the ear-piercing.
Description of the specific rules for consecration

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. .
vṛkṣādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca uttameṣūttamaṃ caret..
madhyemadhye kaniṣṭhā tu kaniṣṭhaṃ parikīrtitam..1..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ।
वृक्षादीनां प्रतिष्ठां च उत्तमेषूत्तमं चरेत्॥
मध्येमध्ये कनिष्ठा तु कनिष्ठं परिकीर्तितम्॥1॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / One should perform the consecration of trees and the like: the best for the best, / the middling for the middling, and the least is prescribed for the least.

2.3.s:
vartulaṃ maṃḍalaṃ kuryāttattu śīrṣe tathāntyake..
madhye vā vedikāṃ kuryāttanmadhye kuṃḍamaṃḍalam..2..
2.3.d:
वर्तुलं मंडलं कुर्यात्तत्तु शीर्षे तथान्त्यके॥
मध्ये वा वेदिकां कुर्यात्तन्मध्ये कुंडमंडलम्॥2॥
2.3.m: One should make a circular diagram at the head as well as at the end, / or make an altar in the middle, and within it the circle of the sacrificial pit.

2.3.s:
pūrvedyū rātrisamaye ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet..
śeṣaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatpṛthivīṃ ca śivaṃ tathā.. 3 ..
2.3.d:
पूर्वेद्यू रात्रिसमये घटं संस्थाप्य पूजयेत्॥
शेषं संपूज्य विधिवत्पृथिवीं च शिवं तथा॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: On the previous day at night, having set up a pot, he should worship it; / having duly worshipped Śeṣa, the Earth, and Śiva,

2.3.s:
gaṃdhatoyena gāyatryā setuṃ saṃpūjya mokṣayet..
kayāneti ca mantreṇa āpyāyasveti vai ṛcā .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
गंधतोयेन गायत्र्या सेतुं संपूज्य मोक्षयेत्॥
कयानेति च मन्त्रेण आप्यायस्वेति वै ऋचा ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: having worshipped the causeway with perfumed water and the Gāyatrī, he should release it; / and with the mantra beginning with 'kayā naḥ', and with the verse 'āpyāyasva'

2.3.s:
dadyādgandhādikaṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīriti candanam ..
dūrvāmantreṇa dūrvāśca phalamantreṇa vai phalam .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
दद्याद्गन्धादिकं श्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीरिति चन्दनम् ॥
दूर्वामन्त्रेण दूर्वाश्च फलमन्त्रेण वै फलम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: he should offer perfume and other items, and sandalwood paste with 'śrīś ca te lakṣmīś ca'; / dūrvā grass with the dūrvā-mantra, and fruit with the fruit-mantra;

2.3.s:
śannodevīti mantreṇa dadyātkuśapavitrakam ..
surāsureti mantreṇa pradadyādvastrayugmakam .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
शन्नोदेवीति मन्त्रेण दद्यात्कुशपवित्रकम् ॥
सुरासुरेति मन्त्रेण प्रदद्याद्वस्त्रयुग्मकम् ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m: with the mantra 'śaṃ no devīḥ' he should give a purifying ring of kuśa grass; / with the mantra 'surāsura' […] he should present a pair of garments.

2.3.s:
añjanālaktakaṃ kuryānmanonnā iti saṃpaṭhan..
kuryācchrāddhaṃ paradine vasudhārāpuraḥsaram .. 7 ..
2.3.d:
अञ्जनालक्तकं कुर्यान्मनोन्ना इति संपठन्॥
कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं परदिने वसुधारापुरःसरम् ॥ 7 ॥
2.3.m: He should apply collyrium and red lac while reciting 'manonnāḥ' […]. / On the following day, he should perform a śrāddha preceded by the continuous stream of ghee.

2.3.s:
varayedatha ācāryaṃ hotāraṃ nṛvaraścaret ..
pātradvayaṃ vidhātavyaṃ sadasyācāryameva ca ..8 ..
2.3.d:
वरयेदथ आचार्यं होतारं नृवरश्चरेत् ॥
पात्रद्वयं विधातव्यं सदस्याचार्यमेव च ॥8 ॥
2.3.m: Then the best of men should choose the preceptor and the hotṛ priest. / Two vessels should be provided, for the member of the assembly and for the preceptor.

2.3.s:
setuyāge vidhātavyaṃ tathā dhānyācalepi ca ..
sahasrahome vaikaṃ tu vivāhe brahmaṛtvijau .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
सेतुयागे विधातव्यं तथा धान्याचलेपि च ॥
सहस्रहोमे वैकं तु विवाहे ब्रह्मऋत्विजौ ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m: This is to be performed in the sacrifice for a causeway, and likewise for a mountain of grain; / in a thousand-oblation fire sacrifice, however, one [vessel suffices]; in a marriage, the brahman and the officiating priests [are chosen].

2.3.s:
yajedenaṃ kṛte mauliyāgārthaṃ yāgamaṃḍapam ..
vedimāvāhayetpūrvaṃ maṃḍapaṃ pratipūjayet .. 2.3.16.10 .. vighnagrahām̐llokapālānsarvasiddhipradāyakān..
2.3.d:
यजेदेनं कृते मौलियागार्थं यागमंडपम् ॥
वेदिमावाहयेत्पूर्वं मंडपं प्रतिपूजयेत् ॥ 2.3.16.10 ॥ विघ्नग्रहाम्̐ल्लोकपालान्सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकान्॥
2.3.m: He should sacrifice in this sacrificial pavilion prepared for the crown-sacrifice. / First he should invoke the altar and worship the pavilion, along with the Vināyakas, the planets, and the world protectors who bestow all perfections.

2.3.s: sthaṃḍile sarvatobhadre śeṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ pradarśayet .. 11..
2.3.d: स्थंडिले सर्वतोभद्रे शेषं विष्णुं प्रदर्शयेत् ॥ 11॥
2.3.m: On a sarvatobhadra diagram on bare ground, he should exhibit Śeṣa and Viṣṇu.

2.3.s:
tatraiva tu varāhākhyaṃ pratītamṛtviguttamam ..
sthālīpākena juhuyādaṣṭāviṃśatikatrayam .. 12 ..
2.3.d:
तत्रैव तु वराहाख्यं प्रतीतमृत्विगुत्तमम् ॥
स्थालीपाकेन जुहुयादष्टाविंशतिकत्रयम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.3.m: Right there, the well-known and excellent officiating priest named Varāha / should sacrifice with the domestic cooked oblation three times twenty-eight [times].

2.3.s:
ājyena tu varāhasya homapañcakamīritam .
tatastilayavenaiva ekaikāmāhutiṃ kramāt .. 13 ..
2.3.d:
आज्येन तु वराहस्य होमपञ्चकमीरितम् ।
ततस्तिलयवेनैव एकैकामाहुतिं क्रमात् ॥ 13 ॥
2.3.m: A pentad of oblations of clarified butter is prescribed for Varāha. / Then, with sesame and barley, he should offer single oblations in succession.

2.3.s:
baliṃ dadyātpṛthagrūpaṃ śeṣayedvidhipūrvakam ..
piṣṭakānnaṃ ghṛtānnaṃ ca vistare vā guḍaudanam .. 14 ..
2.3.d:
बलिं दद्यात्पृथग्रूपं शेषयेद्विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
पिष्टकान्नं घृतान्नं च विस्तरे वा गुडौदनम् ॥ 14 ॥
2.3.m: He should offer a distinct offering, leaving remnants according to rule: / food made of flour and food mixed with clarified butter, or, at length, boiled rice with jaggery;

2.3.s:
māṣabhaktaṃ tu lokāya pṛthivyai paramānnakam ..
vākyapūrvaṃ sṛjeddhīro vākyaprakaraṇaṃ śṛṇu .. 15 ..
2.3.d:
माषभक्तं तु लोकाय पृथिव्यै परमान्नकम् ॥
वाक्यपूर्वं सृजेद्धीरो वाक्यप्रकरणं शृणु ॥ 15 ॥
2.3.m: boiled rice with black gram for the people, and sweet milk-rice for the Earth. / The wise man should release it preceded by the recitation of the formula; listen to the section of the formula:

2.3.s:
( oṃ adyetyādi ekaviṃśatikulasya viśiṣṭasvargaprāptaya imaṃ setuṃ saṃkramasametaṃ viṣṇudaivataṃ surapūjitaṃ vidhivadvāsudevasya prītaye'hamutsṛje ..)
baddhāṃñjaliḥ paṭhenmantraṃ kuryācca vidhivattataḥ ..
picchile patitānāṃ ca udgatenāṅgabhaṅgataḥ ..
pratiṣṭhite dharmasetau dharmo me syānna pātakam .. 16 ..
2.3.d:
( ओं अद्येत्यादि एकविंशतिकुलस्य विशिष्टस्वर्गप्राप्तय इमं सेतुं संक्रमसमेतं विष्णुदैवतं सुरपूजितं विधिवद्वासुदेवस्य प्रीतयेऽहमुत्सृजे ॥)
बद्धांञ्जलिः पठेन्मन्त्रं कुर्याच्च विधिवत्ततः ॥
पिच्छिले पतितानां च उद्गतेनाङ्गभङ्गतः ॥
प्रतिष्ठिते धर्मसेतौ धर्मो मे स्यान्न पातकम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.3.m: ('Om, today, etc., for the attainment of the highest heaven by twenty-one ancestral generations, I release according to rule this causeway, complete with a bridge, dedicated to Viṣṇu and worshipped by the gods, for the pleasure of Vāsudeva.') / Joining his palms, he should recite the mantra and then act according to rule: / 'For those who have slipped and fallen on slippery ground, whose limbs are broken from falling, / when this righteous causeway is established, may merit accrue to me, not sin.

2.3.s:
setorasya prabandhasya śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
ye cātra prāṇinaḥ santi sarveṣāṃ prāṇadhārakāḥ .. 17 ..
2.3.d:
सेतोरस्य प्रबन्धस्य श्रद्धया परया युतः ॥
ये चात्र प्राणिनः सन्ति सर्वेषां प्राणधारकाः ॥ 17 ॥
2.3.m: Endowed with supreme faith in the construction of this causeway, / for all living beings who are here, [may it be] a sustainer of their lives.

2.3.s:
vedāgamena yatpuṇyaṃ kathitaṃ setubandhane ..
tatpuṇyaṃ tu mayā deva pātheye hi samarpitam .. 18 ..
2.3.d:
वेदागमेन यत्पुण्यं कथितं सेतुबन्धने ॥
तत्पुण्यं तु मया देव पाथेये हि समर्पितम् ॥ 18 ॥
2.3.m: Whatever merit has been declared in the Vedic tradition regarding the building of a causeway, / that merit, O Lord, has indeed been dedicated by me as provisions for the journey.'

2.3.s:
yūpaṃ dadyāditi mantreṇa ante cāpi tathā dhvajān ..
vidhivaddakṣiṇāṃ dadyātkulāni nava pañca vā .. 19 ..
2.3.d:
यूपं दद्यादिति मन्त्रेण अन्ते चापि तथा ध्वजान् ॥
विधिवद्दक्षिणां दद्यात्कुलानि नव पञ्च वा ॥ 19 ॥
2.3.m: He should set up a sacrificial post with the mantra, and at the end likewise the banners. / He should give a sacrificial fee according to rule, [benefiting] nine or five ancestral generations.

2.3.s:
pūrṇāṃ dattvā savitre'rghyaṃ dattvā ca svagṛhaṃ vrajet ..
anātape kṣudrasetoḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivaccaret .. 2.3.16.20 ..
2.3.d:
पूर्णां दत्त्वा सवित्रेऽर्घ्यं दत्त्वा च स्वगृहं व्रजेत् ॥
अनातपे क्षुद्रसेतोः प्रतिष्ठां विधिवच्चरेत् ॥ 2.3.16.20 ॥
2.3.m: Having offered the full oblation and presented water for the guest to the Sun, he should go to his house. / One should duly perform the consecration of a small causeway when there is no heat.

2.3.s:
pūrvaṃ ca dadhivāsaṃ ca prabhāte viprabhojanam ..
setumadhyaṃ tato gatvā gandhādīnvidhivaccaret .. 21 ..
2.3.d:
पूर्वं च दधिवासं च प्रभाते विप्रभोजनम् ॥
सेतुमध्यं ततो गत्वा गन्धादीन्विधिवच्चरेत् ॥ 21 ॥
2.3.m:
First [perform] the preliminary consecration with curd, and in the morning the feeding of brahmins.
Then, having gone to the middle of the bridge, he should perform [the rites with] perfumes and the rest according to rule.

2.3.s:
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ hutāśaṃ ca ekakuṇḍe samarcayet ..
vāstoṣpatiṃ yajettatra homaṃ tilayavena tu .. 22 ..
2.3.d:
विष्णुं शिवं हुताशं च एककुण्डे समर्चयेत् ॥
वास्तोष्पतिं यजेत्तत्र होमं तिलयवेन तु ॥ 22 ॥
2.3.m:
He should worship Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the sacrificial fire in a single sacrificial pit;
there he should sacrifice to Vāstoṣpati, making an oblation with sesame and barley.

2.3.s:
kuryādekaikaśo viprā aṣṭā viṃśatisaṃkhyayā ..
utsṛjya dāpayeddhūpaṃ dhvajavarjyaṃ hi sattamāḥ ..
jñātibhiḥ saha bhuñjīta kṛtakṛtyo'bhidhīyate .. 23 .. ..
gopracāravidhivarṇanam
2.3.d:
कुर्यादेकैकशो विप्रा अष्टा विंशतिसंख्यया ॥
उत्सृज्य दापयेद्धूपं ध्वजवर्ज्यं हि सत्तमाः ॥
ज्ञातिभिः सह भुञ्जीत कृतकृत्योऽभिधीयते ॥ 23 ॥ ॥
गोप्रचारविधिवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
The brahmins should offer [the oblations] individually, twenty-eight in number.
Having renounced [the bridge], O best of men, he should present incense, but omitting the banner;
he should eat together with his kin, [and thus] he is said to have accomplished his purpose.
Description of the rules for a cow-pasture

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatra daṃḍe ca viprendrāścaturasre samaṃtataḥ ..
ṣaṣṭihastamitāṃ bhūmiṃ tasya pūrṇāṃ manoramām .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
तत्र दंडे च विप्रेन्द्राश्चतुरस्रे समंततः ॥
षष्टिहस्तमितां भूमिं तस्य पूर्णां मनोरमाम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m:
Sūta said:
There, O foremost of brahmins, on a plot square all around,
measuring sixty cubits by the staff, full and charming,

2.3.s:
pracārārthaṃ gavāṃ caiva yo dadyātsusamāhitaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ..2..
2.3.d:
प्रचारार्थं गवां चैव यो दद्यात्सुसमाहितः ॥
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते ॥2॥
2.3.m:
whoever, being well concentrated, donates it for the grazing of cows,
is magnified in the realm of Rudra for sixty thousand years.

2.3.s:
tadardhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ vā samutsṛjet ..
yo dadyātkevalāṃ bhūmiṃ kanyāṃ dāsīṃ tathā vṛṣam .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
तदर्धं च तदर्धं च तदर्धं वा समुत्सृजेत् ॥
यो दद्यात्केवलां भूमिं कन्यां दासीं तथा वृषम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m:
Or he may dedicate half of that, or half of that, or half of that.
Whoever donates bare land, a maiden, a female slave, or a bull,

2.3.s:
alaṃkāraṃ vinā dhenuṃ phalasyārdhaṃ prakīrtitam..
amaṇḍape śubhe sthāne śarkarādivivarjite .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
अलंकारं विना धेनुं फलस्यार्धं प्रकीर्तितम्॥
अमण्डपे शुभे स्थाने शर्करादिविवर्जिते ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m:
[or] a cow without adornment—half of the fruit is proclaimed [for him].
In an auspicious place without a pavilion, free of pebbles and the like,

2.3.s:
dvihastavedikāmadhye prakuryātsetumaṃḍapam..
tatra saṃpūjayedbhadraṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca śacīpatim .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
द्विहस्तवेदिकामध्ये प्रकुर्यात्सेतुमंडपम्॥
तत्र संपूजयेद्भद्रं ब्रह्माणं च शचीपतिम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m:
he should erect a bridge pavilion in the middle of a two-cubit altar;
there he should worship Bhadra, Brahmā, and the lord of Śacī,

2.3.s:
gaṇeśaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca śeṣaṃ caiva digīśvarān ..
pañcopacārairvidhivatpūjayetpāyasādinā .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
गणेशं क्षेत्रपालं च शेषं चैव दिगीश्वरान् ॥
पञ्चोपचारैर्विधिवत्पूजयेत्पायसादिना ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m:
Gaṇeśa, Kṣetrapāla, Śeṣa, and the lords of the directions;
he should worship them according to rule with five offerings, with milk-rice and other [foods].

2.3.s:
sthālīpākena juhuyādante vai viprabhojanam ..
atra yāge śrāddhavarjyaṃ pūrvedyuradhivāsayet .. 7 ..
2.3.d:
स्थालीपाकेन जुहुयादन्ते वै विप्रभोजनम् ॥
अत्र यागे श्राद्धवर्ज्यं पूर्वेद्युरधिवासयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
2.3.m:
He should offer oblations with a boiled rice dish, and at the end feed brahmins.
In this sacrifice, omitting the ancestral rites, he should perform the preliminary consecration on the previous day.

2.3.s:
tryambakenaiva maṃtreṇa bhūmiṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet ..
tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa gandhatailaṃ sacandanam .. 8 ..
2.3.d:
त्र्यम्बकेनैव मंत्रेण भूमिं संस्थाप्य पूजयेत् ॥
तद्विष्णोरिति मंत्रेण गन्धतैलं सचन्दनम् ॥ 8 ॥
2.3.m:
Having installed the ground with the Tryambaka mantra, he should worship it;
with the mantra beginning "Tad Viṣṇoḥ" [he should offer] perfumed oil mixed with sandalwood,

2.3.s:
pradadyādasunīteti punastu naiva sthāpayet ..
pañcagavyena ca punaḥ śrīścateti ca puṣpakam .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
प्रदद्यादसुनीतेति पुनस्तु नैव स्थापयेत् ॥
पञ्चगव्येन च पुनः श्रीश्चतेति च पुष्पकम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m:
and with [the mantra beginning] "Asunīte" he should present it, but he must not install it again;
and again with the five products of the cow, and a flower with [the mantra beginning] "Śrīś ca te".

2.3.s:
evaṃ yūpasya ca tathā adhigṛhṇāti maṃtrakam ..
gandhadvāreti gandhena aṃśunāteti tailakam .. 2.3.17.10 ..
2.3.d:
एवं यूपस्य च तथा अधिगृह्णाति मंत्रकम् ॥
गन्धद्वारेति गन्धेन अंशुनातेति तैलकम् ॥ 2.3.17.10 ॥
2.3.m:
In this way he takes up the mantra for the sacrificial post:
with perfume [using the mantra beginning] "Gandhadvārā", and oil with [the mantra beginning] "Aṃśunā te",

2.3.s:
surāsureti kusumaṃ dūrvāmantreṇa dūrvikām ..
prabhāte pūjayeddevānrudramuddiśya homayet .. 11 ..
2.3.d:
सुरासुरेति कुसुमं दूर्वामन्त्रेण दूर्विकाम् ॥
प्रभाते पूजयेद्देवान्रुद्रमुद्दिश्य होमयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
2.3.m:
a flower with [the mantra beginning] "Surāsura", and dūrvā grass with the dūrvā mantra.
In the morning he should worship the gods and make an oblation dedicated to Rudra,

2.3.s:
sthālīpākena vidhinā anyeṣāṃ pūrvavaccaret ..
utsṛjyāropayeddīpaṃ sthiro bhaveti vai ṛcā .. 12 ..
2.3.d:
स्थालीपाकेन विधिना अन्येषां पूर्ववच्चरेत् ॥
उत्सृज्यारोपयेद्दीपं स्थिरो भवेति वै ऋचा ॥ 12 ॥
2.3.m:
according to the rule of the boiled rice dish; for the others he should proceed as before.
Having renounced [the site], he should raise a lamp with the verse beginning "Be firm".

2.3.s:
taṃtreṇa nirmitaṃ kuryātsakalaṃ ca trihastakam ..
hastaikaṃ prāpayenmadhye kṣetre caiva viśeṣataḥ .. 13 ..
2.3.d:
तंत्रेण निर्मितं कुर्यात्सकलं च त्रिहस्तकम् ॥
हस्तैकं प्रापयेन्मध्ये क्षेत्रे चैव विशेषतः ॥ 13 ॥
2.3.m:
He should make everything fashioned according to the Tantric manual three cubits [in size];
especially in the field, he should cause one cubit [of it] to reach into the middle.

2.3.s:
sthāpayettatra mantreṇa pañcagavyena yatnataḥ ..
madhuvāteti madhunā āpyāyasveti vai dadhi .. 14 ..
2.3.d:
स्थापयेत्तत्र मन्त्रेण पञ्चगव्येन यत्नतः ॥
मधुवातेति मधुना आप्यायस्वेति वै दधि ॥ 14 ॥
2.3.m:
He should diligently install it there with the mantra using the five products of the cow;
with honey [using the mantra beginning] "Madhuvātā", and curd indeed with [the mantra beginning] "Āpyāyasva",

2.3.s:
tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa ghaṭatoyairanantaram ..
pṛthivīṃ ca varāhaṃ ca kūrmamādhavaśaktikān .. 15 ..
2.3.d:
तद्विष्णोरिति मन्त्रेण घटतोयैरनन्तरम् ॥
पृथिवीं च वराहं च कूर्ममाधवशक्तिकान् ॥ 15 ॥
2.3.m:
and immediately after, with jar-waters using the mantra beginning "Tad Viṣṇoḥ".
[He should worship] the Earth, Varāha, Kūrma, Mādhava, the Śaktis,

2.3.s:
vāstoṣpatiṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca yūpe saṃpūjayetkramāt..
dadyādarghyaṃ ca vivare garte homaṃ vivarjayet .. 16 ..
2.3.d:
वास्तोष्पतिं च विष्णुं च यूपे संपूजयेत्क्रमात्॥
दद्यादर्घ्यं च विवरे गर्ते होमं विवर्जयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
2.3.m:
Vāstoṣpati, and Viṣṇu in order on the sacrificial post;
he should present the guest-water into the cavity, [but] should avoid an oblation in the pit.

2.3.s:
arghyapātre ca duṣṭe ca hastenotsṛjya sattamāḥ ..
( oṃ adyetyādi gobrāhmaṇasarvasattvebhyaḥ paryaṭanārthāya imāṃ bhūmiṃ supūjitāṃ viṣṇudaivatāṃ gopracārarūpiṇīṃ śrutismṛtyādyuktaphalaprāptaye'hamutsṛje ..) śivalokasthitā gāvaḥ sarvadevaiḥ supūjitāḥ ..
evaṃ nivedayedvipro gopracāraṃ samāhitaḥ ..
sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 17 ..
2.3.d:
अर्घ्यपात्रे च दुष्टे च हस्तेनोत्सृज्य सत्तमाः ॥
( ओं अद्येत्यादि गोब्राह्मणसर्वसत्त्वेभ्यः पर्यटनार्थाय इमां भूमिं सुपूजितां विष्णुदैवतां गोप्रचाररूपिणीं श्रुतिस्मृत्याद्युक्तफलप्राप्तयेऽहमुत्सृजे ॥) शिवलोकस्थिता गावः सर्वदेवैः सुपूजिताः ॥
एवं निवेदयेद्विप्रो गोप्रचारं समाहितः ॥
स मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 17 ॥
2.3.m:
And O best of men, having poured out [water] with the hand into the vessel for guest-water,
("Om, on this day, etc., for the wandering of cows, brahmins, and all living beings, I dedicate this well-worshipped land, which has Viṣṇu as its deity and has the form of a pasture for cows, for the attainment of the fruit declared in the Śrutis, Smṛtis, and other texts.") "Cows reside in the world of Śiva, well-worshipped by all the gods."
In this manner, a concentrated brahmin should dedicate the pasture for cows;
freed from all sins, he is magnified in the realm of Viṣṇu.

2.3.s:
yāvaṃti tṛṇagulmāni saṃti bhūmau śubhāni ca ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate .. 18 .. ..
dinaikasādhyapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
2.3.d:
यावंति तृणगुल्मानि संति भूमौ शुभानि च ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 18 ॥ ॥
दिनैकसाध्यप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
As many auspicious blades of grass and bushes as there are on the land,
for that many thousands of years he is magnified in the heavenly world.
Description of the rule for consecration to be accomplished in a single day

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kalau caikāhasādhyena pratiṣṭhāmalpavittavān ..
sadyodhivāsamājyena prakuryāttāṃtrikottamaḥ .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
कलौ चैकाहसाध्येन प्रतिष्ठामल्पवित्तवान् ॥
सद्योधिवासमाज्येन प्रकुर्यात्तांत्रिकोत्तमः ॥ 1 ॥

2.3.s:
uttaraṃ tu gate haṃse atīte cottarāyaṇe ..
śaratkāle vyatīte tu vasaṃte yajñamārabhet .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
उत्तरं तु गते हंसे अतीते चोत्तरायणे ॥
शरत्काले व्यतीते तु वसंते यज्ञमारभेत् ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m:
When the sun has moved to the north, when the northern course of the sun has begun,
and when autumn has passed, he should begin the sacrifice in the spring.

2.3.s:
nārāyaṇādimūrtīnāṃ dvātriṃśadbheda eva tu ..
pratiṣṭhāṃ pratimānāṃ ca gajāsyādīṃśca sattamāḥ .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
नारायणादिमूर्तीनां द्वात्रिंशद्भेद एव तु ॥
प्रतिष्ठां प्रतिमानां च गजास्यादींश्च सत्तमाः ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m:
For the thirty-two varieties of the images of Nārāyaṇa and others,
and the consecration of images of the Elephant-faced God and others, O best of men,

2.3.s:
nityaṃ nirvartya matimānkuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ ..
viprānsaṃbhojayedvātha tato yāgagṛhaṃ vrajet .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
नित्यं निर्वर्त्य मतिमान्कुर्यादभ्युदयं ततः ॥
विप्रान्संभोजयेद्वाथ ततो यागगृहं व्रजेत् ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m:
having completed the daily rite, the wise man should then perform the rite of prosperity;
or he should feed brahmins, and then go to the sacrificial hall.

2.3.s:
gaṇeśa grahadikpālānpratikuṃbheṣu pūjayet ..
sthaṃḍile pūjayedviṣṇuṃ parivāragaṇaṃ yajet .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
गणेश ग्रहदिक्पालान्प्रतिकुंभेषु पूजयेत् ॥
स्थंडिले पूजयेद्विष्णुं परिवारगणं यजेत् ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m:
He should worship Gaṇeśa, the planets, and the guardians of the directions in individual jars;
he should worship Viṣṇu on a bare sacrificial ground, and sacrifice to his retinue.

2.3.s:
snāpayetprathamaṃ devaṃ toyaiḥ pañcavidhairapi ..
pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ paṃcamṛtpiṇḍakairapi .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
स्नापयेत्प्रथमं देवं तोयैः पञ्चविधैरपि ॥
पञ्चामृतैः पञ्चगव्यैः पंचमृत्पिण्डकैरपि ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m:
He should first bathe the god with five kinds of water,
with the five nectars, the five products of the cow, and five balls of clay,

2.3.s:
tilatailaiśca snehaiśca kaṣāyairapi sattamāḥ ..
pañcapuṣpodakairvātha tripadairapi sattamāḥ .. 7 ..
2.3.d:
तिलतैलैश्च स्नेहैश्च कषायैरपि सत्तमाः ॥
पञ्चपुष्पोदकैर्वाथ त्रिपदैरपि सत्तमाः ॥ 7 ॥
2.3.m:
with sesame oils, unctuous substances, and astringents, O best of men;
or with water of five flowers, and also with three leaves, O best of men.

2.3.s:
tulasīkusumāpuṣpapatrāṇyāhustripatrakam ..
pañcakāmraśamīpadmakaravīraṃ ca paṃcakam ..8..
2.3.d:
तुलसीकुसुमापुष्पपत्राण्याहुस्त्रिपत्रकम् ॥
पञ्चकाम्रशमीपद्मकरवीरं च पंचकम् ॥8॥
2.3.m:
They declare tulasī, flower, and non-flower leaves to be the "three-leaf";
the fivefold set is mango, śamī, lotus, and karavīra as the fifth.

2.3.s:
mṛttikā karidaṃtasya tathāśvakhuramṛttikā ..
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpistu paṃcamam .. .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
मृत्तिका करिदंतस्य तथाश्वखुरमृत्तिका ॥
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिस्तु पंचमम् ॥ ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m:
Clay from an elephant's tusk, and likewise clay from a horse's hoof;
cow-urine, cow-dung, milk, curd, and clarified butter as the fifth.

2.3.s:
kuryātprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ ca homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi ..
dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivaddadyātpūrṇāṃ tu tadanaṃtaram .. 2.3.18.10 ..
devādipratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
2.3.d:
कुर्यात्प्राणप्रतिष्ठां च होमं कुर्याद्यथाविधि ॥
दक्षिणां विधिवद्दद्यात्पूर्णां तु तदनंतरम् ॥ 2.3.18.10 ॥
देवादिप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम्

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ tu viprendrāḥ kālyādīnāṃ tathaiva ca ..
adhivāsya ca pūrvedyuḥ śrāddhamabhyudayātmakam .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं तु विप्रेन्द्राः काल्यादीनां तथैव च ॥
अधिवास्य च पूर्वेद्युः श्राद्धमभ्युदयात्मकम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m:
Sūta said:
Hereafter, O foremost of brahmins, for Kālī and the others likewise,
having performed the preliminary consecration on the previous day, [he performs] the ancestral rite of prosperity.

2.3.s:
prathame jalajaiḥ snānaṃ pañcagavyairanaṃtaram ..
pūrvavacca vidhānena kuṃbhe durgāṃ samarcayet .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
प्रथमे जलजैः स्नानं पञ्चगव्यैरनंतरम् ॥
पूर्ववच्च विधानेन कुंभे दुर्गां समर्चयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m:
First [takes place] the bathing with waters from lotuses, and immediately after with the five products of the cow;
and according to rule, as before, he should worship Durgā in a jar.

2.3.s:
pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ karīṣaśatadhārayā ..
śrībilve pūjayeddevīṃ dadyātprāṇamanaṃtaram .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
पञ्चामृतैः पञ्चगव्यैः करीषशतधारया ॥
श्रीबिल्वे पूजयेद्देवीं दद्यात्प्राणमनंतरम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m:
With the five nectars, the five products of the cow, and a hundred-stream bath of cow-dung water,
he should worship the goddess on an auspicious bilva tree, and immediately after impart the breath of life.

2.3.s:
bilvapatraiḥ phalairvāpi dadyāccāpi śatāhutīḥ ..
ekaikaśastu sarveṣāṃ dadyātkāñcana dakṣiṇām .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
बिल्वपत्रैः फलैर्वापि दद्याच्चापि शताहुतीः ॥
एकैकशस्तु सर्वेषां दद्यात्काञ्चन दक्षिणाम् ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m:
With bilva leaves or fruits he should offer one hundred oblations;
and he should give a fee of gold to all of them individually.

2.3.s:
pratimāṃ kālikāyāśca tārāyāśca pṛthakpṛthak ..
grāhyaṃ vinārcayedviprāḥ pañcapañcaśatairapi .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
प्रतिमां कालिकायाश्च तारायाश्च पृथक्पृथक् ॥
ग्राह्यं विनार्चयेद्विप्राः पञ्चपञ्चशतैरपि ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m:
The image of Kālikā and that of Tārā separately,
without taking [a fee], O brahmins, he should worship even with sets of five, five, and a hundred.

2.3.s:
bhojayetsnāpayeddevo gaṃdhatoyairdinatrayam ..
tāmrakuṃbhe'rcayeddevīṃ tridinaṃ prātareva hi .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
भोजयेत्स्नापयेद्देवो गंधतोयैर्दिनत्रयम् ॥
ताम्रकुंभेऽर्चयेद्देवीं त्रिदिनं प्रातरेव हि ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m:
The god should be fed and bathed with perfumed waters for three days;
he should worship the goddess in a copper jar for three days, in the morning alone.

2.3.s:
samīraṇaṃ tato dadyātpeṭikāyāṃ niveśayet ..
tato'pi gandhatoyaiśca snāpayetkanyakādibhiḥ.. .. 7 ..
2.3.d:
समीरणं ततो दद्यात्पेटिकायां निवेशयेत् ॥
ततोऽपि गन्धतोयैश्च स्नापयेत्कन्यकादिभिः॥ ॥ 7 ॥
2.3.m:
Then he should offer wind [with a fan] and place [her] in a small chest;
then he should also bathe [her] with perfumed waters by means of young maidens and others.

2.3.s:
tato vai cāṣṭamadine rātrāvapi prapūjayet ..
paśudānaṃ prakartavyamagnikāryaṃ ca pāyasaiḥ .. 8 ..
2.3.d:
ततो वै चाष्टमदिने रात्रावपि प्रपूजयेत् ॥
पशुदानं प्रकर्तव्यमग्निकार्यं च पायसैः ॥ 8 ॥
2.3.m: Then, on the eighth day, one should worship even at night. / An animal sacrifice must be performed, as well as a fire-ritual with milk-porridges.

2.3.s:
śivaliṅgapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye taṃtramataṃ yathā ..
trivipraṃ bhojayedviprā adhivāsyaṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
शिवलिङ्गप्रतिष्ठां च वक्ष्ये तंत्रमतं यथा ॥
त्रिविप्रं भोजयेद्विप्रा अधिवास्यं विशेषतः ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m: And I shall explain the installation of the Śiva-liṅga according to the doctrine of the Tantras. / One should feed three brāhmaṇas, O brāhmaṇas, after especially performing the preliminary consecration.

2.3.s:
nityaṃ samāpya ca punaḥ kuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ ..
ācāryaṃ varayetprātaḥ snāpayetpūrvavartmanā ..2.3.19.10..
2.3.d:
नित्यं समाप्य च पुनः कुर्यादभ्युदयं ततः ॥
आचार्यं वरयेत्प्रातः स्नापयेत्पूर्ववर्त्मना ॥2.3.19.10॥
2.3.m: And having finished the daily rite, one should then perform the prosperity rite. / In the morning one should select the preceptor [and] bathe [the liṅga] in the manner previously described.

2.3.s:
parivāragaṇaiḥ sārddhamarcayettadanaṃtaram ..
dadyātsamīraṇaṃ paścādagnikāryaṃ samācaret .. 11 ..
2.3.d:
परिवारगणैः सार्द्धमर्चयेत्तदनंतरम् ॥
दद्यात्समीरणं पश्चादग्निकार्यं समाचरेत् ॥ 11 ॥
2.3.m: Immediately thereafter one should worship [it] together with the attendant hosts. / Afterwards one should provide air and carry out the fire-ritual.

2.3.s:
tilahemamayīṃ gāṃ ca dadyādgāṃ ca vidhānataḥ ..
na nāma na ca gotraṃ ca homakarmaṇi sarvadā .. 12 ..
2.3.d:
तिलहेममयीं गां च दद्याद्गां च विधानतः ॥
न नाम न च गोत्रं च होमकर्मणि सर्वदा ॥ 12 ॥
2.3.m: And one should give a cow made of sesame and gold, and also give a [live] cow according to the rules. / Neither name nor lineage [should be uttered] in the burnt-offering ritual at any time,

2.3.s:
pūrṇimāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa nānyeṣāṃ ca kathaṃcana ..
homāṃte vasudhārāṃ ca kuṃbhe dattvā vidhānataḥ .. 13 ..
2.3.d:
पूर्णिमायां विशेषेण नान्येषां च कथंचन ॥
होमांते वसुधारां च कुंभे दत्त्वा विधानतः ॥ 13 ॥
2.3.m: especially on the full-moon day, and under no circumstances for any others. / At the end of the burnt offering, having offered the continuous stream of clarified butter into the jar according to the rules,

2.3.s:
trihastacarakāyaṃ ca hastaikaṃ caturhastake ..
śālaśamaśilāyāśca pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivaccaret .. 14 ..
2.3.d:
त्रिहस्तचरकायं च हस्तैकं चतुर्हस्तके ॥
शालशमशिलायाश्च प्रतिष्ठां विधिवच्चरेत् ॥ 14 ॥
2.3.m: for a movable body of three cubits, [or] one cubit in a four-cubit [shrine], / one should perform the installation of the stone from Śālaśama according to rule.

2.3.s:
sadyodhivāsayeddevaṃ dvādaśyāṃ snāpayedatha ..
ratnatoyaiḥ parimalaistrigaṃdhaiḥ paṃcapallavaiḥ .. 15 ..
2.3.d:
सद्योधिवासयेद्देवं द्वादश्यां स्नापयेदथ ॥
रत्नतोयैः परिमलैस्त्रिगंधैः पंचपल्लवैः ॥ 15 ॥
2.3.m: One should immediately consecrate the deity, and then bathe [it] on the twelfth [lunar day] / with jewel-waters, fragrant scents, the three perfumes, and the five shoots.

2.3.s:
kuṃbhe prajāpatiṃ sthāpya śvetābjaṃ navanābhake ..
navadurgoktamārgeṇa pūjayetparameśvaram .. 16 ..
2.3.d:
कुंभे प्रजापतिं स्थाप्य श्वेताब्जं नवनाभके ॥
नवदुर्गोक्तमार्गेण पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.3.m: Having placed Prajāpati in the jar, and a white lotus on the nine-navelled [maṇḍala], / one should worship the Supreme Lord in the manner taught for the Nine Durgās.

2.3.s:
cakrasvarūpato jñeyaṃ pradadyācca samīraṇam ..
ānīya tāmrabhāṃḍe ca trikālaṃ pratipūjayet ..17..
2.3.d:
चक्रस्वरूपतो ज्ञेयं प्रदद्याच्च समीरणम् ॥
आनीय ताम्रभांडे च त्रिकालं प्रतिपूजयेत् ॥17॥
2.3.m: It should be understood in the form of a disc, and one should provide air. / Having brought [it] in a copper vessel, one should worship it at the three junctures of the day.

2.3.s:
pāyasānnairutpalairvā paṅkajairvāpi homayet ..
sakāñcanaṃ vastrayugmaṃ prada dyādbhūridakṣiṇam .. 18 ..
2.3.d:
पायसान्नैरुत्पलैर्वा पङ्कजैर्वापि होमयेत् ॥
सकाञ्चनं वस्त्रयुग्मं प्रद द्याद्भूरिदक्षिणम् ॥ 18 ॥
2.3.m: One should make burnt offerings with milk-rice dishes, blue lotuses, or lotuses. / One should give a pair of garments with gold, [and] an abundant sacrificial fee.

2.3.s:
śrīsūryasya gaṇeśasya viriñceścāpi sattamāḥ ..
vaṭavṛkṣāṃtikaṃ gatvā sthāpayedvaruṇaṃ tataḥ .. 19 ..
2.3.d:
श्रीसूर्यस्य गणेशस्य विरिञ्चेश्चापि सत्तमाः ॥
वटवृक्षांतिकं गत्वा स्थापयेद्वरुणं ततः ॥ 19 ॥
2.3.m: [For the installation] of glorious Sūrya, of Gaṇeśa, and of Viriñci, O best of men, / having gone near a banyan tree, one should then establish Varuṇa.

2.3.s:
raktābje pūjayetsūryaṃ parivārasamanvitam ..
aṣṭāviṃśatibhirddattvā dadyātprāṇamanaṃtaram .. 2.3.19.20 ..
2.3.d:
रक्ताब्जे पूजयेत्सूर्यं परिवारसमन्वितम् ॥
अष्टाविंशतिभिर्द्दत्त्वा दद्यात्प्राणमनंतरम् ॥ 2.3.19.20 ॥
2.3.m: One should worship Sūrya along with his retinue on a red lotus. / Having offered with twenty-eight [mantras], one should immediately bestow the vital breath.

2.3.s:
ekāhamathavākāśe guptaṃ kṛtvā dinatrayam ..
tryahādeva punaḥ pūjāṃ punarhomaṃ samācaret .. 21 ..
2.3.d:
एकाहमथवाकाशे गुप्तं कृत्वा दिनत्रयम् ॥
त्र्यहादेव पुनः पूजां पुनर्होमं समाचरेत् ॥ 21 ॥
2.3.m: Having kept it hidden in the open space for one day, or else for three days, / after three days one should perform the worship again and the burnt offering again.

2.3.s:
punaśca bhojayedviprāndadyātkāñcanadakṣiṇām ..
vārāhyāstripurāyāśca nārikelodakairapi ..22..
2.3.d:
पुनश्च भोजयेद्विप्रान्दद्यात्काञ्चनदक्षिणाम् ॥
वाराह्यास्त्रिपुरायाश्च नारिकेलोदकैरपि ॥22॥
2.3.m: And again one should feed the brāhmaṇas and give a sacrificial fee of gold. / For Vārāhī and Tripurā, with coconut water,

2.3.s:
sthāpayedvā vidhānena sindūrādyaiḥ samarcayet ..
dadyātsamīraṇaṃ paścātpunaḥ pūjāṃ ca homayet .. 23 ..
2.3.d:
स्थापयेद्वा विधानेन सिन्दूराद्यैः समर्चयेत् ॥
दद्यात्समीरणं पश्चात्पुनः पूजां च होमयेत् ॥ 23 ॥
2.3.m: one should establish [them] according to rule, and worship them with vermilion and other substances. / Afterwards one should provide air, and again worship and make burnt offerings.

2.3.s:
paśujñānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ ṣaṇmāsaiḥ pañcamodakaiḥ ..
kumārīṃ bhojayedrātrau dadyātkāñcana dakṣiṇām .. 24 ..
2.3.d:
पशुज्ञानं च कर्तव्यं षण्मासैः पञ्चमोदकैः ॥
कुमारीं भोजयेद्रात्रौ दद्यात्काञ्चन दक्षिणाम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.3.m: And knowledge of the animal must be carried out for six months with five sweetmeats. / One should feed a maiden at night and give a sacrificial fee of gold.

2.3.s:
pratimāṃ bhuvaneśīṃ ca mahāmāyāmbikāmapi ..
kāmākṣīṃ ca tato devīmindrākṣīṃ cāparājitām .. 25 ..
2.3.d:
प्रतिमां भुवनेशीं च महामायाम्बिकामपि ॥
कामाक्षीं च ततो देवीमिन्द्राक्षीं चापराजिताम् ॥ 25 ॥
2.3.m: For the image of Bhuvaneśī, and Mahāmāyā, Ambikā, / and then the goddess Kāmākṣī, Indrākṣī, and Aparājitā,

2.3.s:
pūrvedyū rātrisamaye piṣṭa kāṣṭau nivedayet ..
aṣṭau nirmāṇayetpaścādbaliṃ cāṣṭau vidhānavit .. 26 ..
2.3.d:
पूर्वेद्यू रात्रिसमये पिष्ट काष्टौ निवेदयेत् ॥
अष्टौ निर्माणयेत्पश्चाद्बलिं चाष्टौ विधानवित् ॥ 26 ॥
2.3.m: on the previous day at night-time, one should offer eight cakes of flour. / Afterwards one who knows the ritual should fashion eight [images] and [offer] eight offerings.

2.3.s:
parivāragaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ pūjayetprayataḥ sudhīḥ ..
samīraṇaṃ tato dadyācchivaṃ sūryaṃ yajetpunaḥ .. 27 ..
2.3.d:
परिवारगणैः सार्द्धं पूजयेत्प्रयतः सुधीः ॥
समीरणं ततो दद्याच्छिवं सूर्यं यजेत्पुनः ॥ 27 ॥
2.3.m: Self-restrained and wise, one should worship [her] together with the attendant hosts. / Then one should provide air, and again sacrifice to Śiva and Sūrya.

2.3.s:
pāyasānnaiśca juhuyāttridinaṃ lipipūjanam ..
kumārīpūjanaṃ kuryādagnikāryaṃ dinatrayam .. 28 ..
2.3.d:
पायसान्नैश्च जुहुयात्त्रिदिनं लिपिपूजनम् ॥
कुमारीपूजनं कुर्यादग्निकार्यं दिनत्रयम् ॥ 28 ॥
2.3.m: And one should make burnt offerings with milk-rice dishes; for three days there should be worship of the script. / One should perform the worship of maidens and the fire-ritual for three days.

2.3.s:
paśudānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vibhave sati sattamāḥ ..
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmaṭhotsavapuraḥsaram ..29..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi tṛtīyabhāge ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..19.. ..
grahopadravotpātaśāntivarṇanam
2.3.d:
पशुदानं च कर्तव्यं विभवे सति सत्तमाः ॥
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यान्मठोत्सवपुरःसरम् ॥29॥
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे मध्यमपर्वणि तृतीयभागे एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः ॥19॥ ॥
ग्रहोपद्रवोत्पातशान्तिवर्णनम्
2.3.m:
And an animal sacrifice should be performed if wealth permits, O best of men. / One should keep vigil at night, preceded by a monastery festival.
Thus ends the nineteenth chapter in the third part of the Madhyamaparvan in the glorious and great Bhaviṣyapurāṇa.
Description of the pacification of portents and afflictions caused by planets

2.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
durnimittānyatho vakṣye śṛṇvaṃtu munisattamāḥ ..
yasya ye grahadoṣāḥ syusteṣāṃ śāṃtiṃ yathākramāt .. 1 ..
2.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
दुर्निमित्तान्यथो वक्ष्ये शृण्वंतु मुनिसत्तमाः ॥
यस्य ये ग्रहदोषाः स्युस्तेषां शांतिं यथाक्रमात् ॥ 1 ॥
2.3.m: Sūta said: / Next I shall proclaim the ill omens; let the best of sages listen! / The pacifications, in their proper order, of whatever planetary afflictions may befall a person.

2.3.s:
divyaṃtarikṣe bhaume cetyevaṃ triḥ parikīrtitam ..
graharkṣādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ divyamāntarikṣaṃ nibodha me .. 2 ..
2.3.d:
दिव्यंतरिक्षे भौमे चेत्येवं त्रिः परिकीर्तितम् ॥
ग्रहर्क्षाद्यैः कृतं दिव्यमान्तरिक्षं निबोध मे ॥ 2 ॥
2.3.m: [Portents] are proclaimed to be threefold: celestial, atmospheric, and terrestrial. / That caused by planets, lunar mansions, and the like is celestial; learn of the atmospheric from me:

2.3.s:
ulkāhito diśo dāhaḥ pariveṣastathaiva ca ..
jalāśayānāṃ vai kṛtyaṃ bhaumaṃ tadapi kīrtitam .. 3 ..
2.3.d:
उल्काहितो दिशो दाहः परिवेषस्तथैव च ॥
जलाशयानां वै कृत्यं भौमं तदपि कीर्तितम् ॥ 3 ॥
2.3.m: The burning of the quarters caused by meteors, and likewise halos. / The unnatural state of reservoirs of water is proclaimed to be terrestrial.

2.3.s:
bhaumaṃ cālpaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ divyāntarikṣameva ca ..
saptāhamaphalaṃ dadyāddaivaṃ cāpi ca tatkṣaṇāt .. 4 ..
2.3.d:
भौमं चाल्पफलं ज्ञेयं दिव्यान्तरिक्षमेव च ॥
सप्ताहमफलं दद्याद्दैवं चापि च तत्क्षणात् ॥ 4 ॥
2.3.m: The terrestrial is to be known as producing small results, and likewise the celestial and atmospheric; / it may yield its result in a week, while the divine produces it instantly.

2.3.s:
devānāṃ hasanaṃ caiva kalkanaṃ rudhirasravaḥ ..
akasmādvyasanaṃ tatra yatra nirghātanirdayaḥ ..
sarpādyārohaṇaṃ caiva daivaṃ tadapi kīrtitam .. 5 ..
2.3.d:
देवानां हसनं चैव कल्कनं रुधिरस्रवः ॥
अकस्माद्व्यसनं तत्र यत्र निर्घातनिर्दयः ॥
सर्पाद्यारोहणं चैव दैवं तदपि कीर्तितम् ॥ 5 ॥
2.3.m: The laughter of deities, trembling, the flow of blood, / sudden calamity where there is a merciless thunderbolt, / and the climbing of serpents and the like—that is also proclaimed to be divine.

2.3.s:
tato meghātsamutpannā yadi vṛṣṭiḥ śilātale ..
saptāhābhyaṃtare jīvamutpannaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet .. 6 ..
2.3.d:
ततो मेघात्समुत्पन्ना यदि वृष्टिः शिलातले ॥
सप्ताहाभ्यंतरे जीवमुत्पन्नं निष्फलं भवेत् ॥ 6 ॥
2.3.m: Then, if rain arising from a cloud falls upon a stone surface, / life that has arisen within a week becomes futile.

2.3.s:
ekarāśisthitāḥ pāpāḥ śanibhaumadivākarāḥ ..
pṛthvī dhūmākulā tatra rudaṃti bahavo janāḥ ..7..
2.3.d:
एकराशिस्थिताः पापाः शनिभौमदिवाकराः ॥
पृथ्वी धूमाकुला तत्र रुदंति बहवो जनाः ॥7॥
2.3.m: When the malefics Saturn, Mars, and the Sun stand in a single zodiacal sign, / the earth is filled with smoke, and many people weep.

2.3.s:
abhicāraṃ gate jīve śanau ca tatra nāgate ..
tatra paśyati rājendraḥ ko dharāṃ dhārayiṣyati..8..
2.3.d:
अभिचारं गते जीवे शनौ च तत्र नागते ॥
तत्र पश्यति राजेन्द्रः को धरां धारयिष्यति॥8॥
2.3.m: When Jupiter has gone to a hostile house and Saturn has not arrived there, / the lord of kings sees there: 'Who will sustain the earth?'

2.3.s:
sūryamapaśyano dvaṃdvaṃ digdāhaśca tathaiva ca ..
darśanaṃ dhūmaketośca nakṣatre dhūmadarśanam .. 9 ..
2.3.d:
सूर्यमपश्यनो द्वंद्वं दिग्दाहश्च तथैव च ॥
दर्शनं धूमकेतोश्च नक्षत्रे धूमदर्शनम् ॥ 9 ॥
2.3.m: A pair unable to see the Sun, and likewise the burning of the quarters, / the appearance of a comet, and the sighting of smoke in a lunar mansion;

2.3.s:
bhūkampa eva māse ca ekamāse tathā dine ..
rājño janmadine vātha śakracāpaṃ dināṃtare .. 2.3.20.10 ..
2.3.d:
भूकम्प एव मासे च एकमासे तथा दिने ॥
राज्ञो जन्मदिने वाथ शक्रचापं दिनांतरे ॥ 2.3.20.10 ॥
2.3.m: an earthquake in a month, or in one month and on that [same] day, / or on the king's birthday, or a rainbow on another day;

2.3.s:
darśanaṃ kharavātasya grahayuddhasya darśanam ..
māsatraye tu grahaṇamulkāpātaprapātanam .. 11 ..
2.3.d:
दर्शनं खरवातस्य ग्रहयुद्धस्य दर्शनम् ॥
मासत्रये तु ग्रहणमुल्कापातप्रपातनम् ॥ 11 ॥
2.3.m: the occurrence of a harsh wind, the occurrence of planetary warfare, / an eclipse within three months, the falling of meteors;

2.3.s:
ākāśe'pyatha bhūmau ca tatra maṇḍūkameva ca ..
haridrāvṛṣṭiḥ pāṣāṇe siṃhabilvākṛtiryadi ..
darśane rāṣṭradurbhikṣamakaraṃ nṛpatikṣayaḥ .. 12..
2.3.d:
आकाशेऽप्यथ भूमौ च तत्र मण्डूकमेव च ॥
हरिद्रावृष्टिः पाषाणे सिंहबिल्वाकृतिर्यदि ॥
दर्शने राष्ट्रदुर्भिक्षमकरं नृपतिक्षयः ॥ 12॥
2.3.m: in the sky or on the earth, and there [the appearance of] a frog, / a rain of turmeric, if on a stone there is the shape of a lion or a bilva fruit— / upon seeing these, there is famine in the realm, trouble, and the destruction of the king.

2.3.s:
caitre kumbhe nadīvegadarśane viplavo bhavet ..
arka syādbhutametaddhi srugyuktaṃ śrapayeccarum .. 13 ..
2.3.d:
चैत्रे कुम्भे नदीवेगदर्शने विप्लवो भवेत् ॥
अर्क स्याद्भुतमेतद्धि स्रुग्युक्तं श्रपयेच्चरुम् ॥ 13 ॥
2.3.m: In Caitra, when [the Sun is in] Aquarius, if a rushing river is seen, there will be catastrophe. / This is indeed a prodigy of the Sun; with a ladle, one should cook a sacrificial porridge.

2.3.s:
ākṛṣṇeneti mantreṇa atha vārkeṇa yatnataḥ ..
prāsādatoraṇaṃ tatra dvāraṃ3.43 prākāraveśma ca .. 14 ..
2.3.d:
आकृष्णेनेति मन्त्रेण अथ वार्केण यत्नतः ॥
प्रासादतोरणं तत्र द्वारं3.43 प्राकारवेश्म च ॥ 14 ॥
2.3.m: With the mantra beginning with 'Ā kṛṣṇena', or diligently with [a hymn to] Arka— / a palace, an archway, a gateway, an enclosure-wall, or a house there;

2.3.s:
dhānyasāraṃ gavāṃ sāraṃ kūpe kumbhapradarśanam ..
ādityasyādbhutaṃ vidyātkamalaṃ juhuyāttataḥ ..15..
2.3.d:
धान्यसारं गवां सारं कूपे कुम्भप्रदर्शनम् ॥
आदित्यस्याद्भुतं विद्यात्कमलं जुहुयात्ततः ॥15॥
